sta bod kyi mkhas pa mi sumasgrub gug ṣ+kagyi'i bkod pa basbyar du bzhengs pa rnam pa/lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i sgrub rganas byin cag— lha cho 4 — zhwa ༷ dilta — 4 tshebyāchiri — 4 4 — — tsā /4 3 cho ci byams sku bdud rtsi rang 'bab kyi lha khang / gnas ri 'a yig rang byon/
—wa misnyosna lha sku'i sh+tsa ༷ —

rten 'brel shis tshigarten 'brel shis tshigarang byung khor yug lta na rab sdug pa/ /sum rtsen lha gnas sa la 'phos sam ci/ /bstan pa'i me ro gsos pa'i grags snyan gyis/ /a chung gnam gyi rdzong chen yin par nges/ /zhes pa 'di ni ku'u ba'i sprul ming 'dzin pa nas/2007 10 3 nyin/zhi bsil phan bde 'byung ba'i sgo gcig pu/ /thub bstan bshad dang sgrub pa'i srol bzang bo/ /dus mthar mi nyams spel ba'i gnas mchog 'di/ /bskal ba'i mthar yang grags pa'i gzhir brtan shog /lha sde skyes ming 'dzin pas/2007 10 3nyin/

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/bde stong chos dbyings spya rgyud gzugs su shar/ /zing zing 'du 'dzi dben pa'i gnam rtod 'dir/ /phyi dar bstan pa'i skya rengs 'drerno byed pa'i/ /mkhas pa mi gsum gnas 'dir yun ring bzhugs/ /sngon rol brtsams pa'i tshad ldan chos 'byung las/ /dmar g.yo gtsang gsum bstan pa spel ba'i tshul/ /lkog gyur don rnams ma 'dres gsal bor brjod/ /bden gtam lha yi rol mo shis gyur cig/ces pa 'di ni mtsho sngon nang bstan slob gling gi dge ming 'dzin pa ldong bsod nams rgya mtshos rang shag zhi bde'i bste gnas nas/2007 9 17nyin/thub bstan srog zungs smad nas gsos pa'i gnas/ /mdo sngags mkhas grub nags su 'khrigs pa'i dpyid/ /lo rgyus bden gtam lha yi rol mo la/ /bsngags pa'i me tog kha ba'i zol gyis gtor/ /zhes rang dgon gyi rigs pa smra ba dge 'dunadar rgyas nas/2007 11 19nyin/ 2

gsal bshad/gsal bshad/ mdo smad a chung gnam rdzong zhes pa'i gnas chen 'di ni deng dus kyi mtsho sngon zhing chen rma lho khul gcan tsha rdzong khams ra grong brdal gyi khongs su yod cing / gna' dus su bod yul du bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'byung gnas yin zhes lo rgyus smra ba rnams kyis zhal bzhes gcig mthun yin te/ 'dir gnam rdzong dgon pa'i dge slong shes rab rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i phyi dar bstan pa'i gnas mchog mdo smad a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus bden gtam lha yi rol mo zhes bya ba bzhugs pa'i nang 'dir/ gna' rabs su a chung gnam rdzong gtso bor gyur ba'i gnubs khams ra'i sa khul du sangs rgyas bstan pa thog mar ji ltar dar tshul dang / bar du 'phel 'grib byung tshul/ da lta'i dus su bstan pa slar gso byas tshul/ grub mtha' gsar rnying khyad med du 'phel rgyas 'byung bzhin yod tshul/ srid gzhung gi bdag gnyer 'og khor yug gi mang tshogs khrod du rig gnas slob gso dang sgyu rtsal/ thon skyed 1

ma chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/dpal 'byor dang spyi tshogs 'cham mthun gyi 'brel ba gsar ba chags bzhin yod tshul bcas mtshams sbyor gnang yod pa la khyad chos lnga tsam yod de/ dang po ltar na/ dus rabs dgu ba'i nang bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum dang lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje sogs dbus gtsang phyogs nas gnubs khams ra'i yul 'dir phebs te sangs rgyas chos lugs dar spel mdzad pa dang / bstan pa snga dar dang khyad par rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i phyag gsol gyi rgyun rnams mtshams sbyor gnang zhing / de nas bzung gcan tsha'i yul gru so sor gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i lugs srol khyab brdal du byung tshul ngo sprod gnang yod/gnyis pa pa ltar na/ bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum a chung gnam rdzong nas bzhugs rjes de las rjes su bzung ba'i 'dul ba'i sdom brgyud ni bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal dang / klu me tshul khrims shes rab sogs byon nas smad 'dul ring lugs bod khams yongs su dar khyab byung tshul dang / lha lung dpal rdor la sogs kyi mdzad 'phrin la brten nas brgyud pa las byung ba'i grub 2

gsal bshad/thob zhi khro rab 'byams pa rnams dang khya/ da par khro bo bcu bo sogs sngon byon dam pa'i lo rgyus mtshams sbyor gnang yod/gsum pa ltar na/ chab srid kyi drag rlung chen po 'tshub pa'i nang khams ra'i yul du dar ba'i sangs rgyas bstan pa dang lo rgyus ring mo'i rig gnas rtsa chen rnams la gnod pa tshabs chen thebs pa/ lo ngo nyi shu'i rjes su rim gyis slar gso byed thub par ma zad/grub mtha' gsar rnying gi ring lugs la phyogs ris med par rang rang so so'i sa nas 'dzin skyong spel gsum la hur brtson byed pa dang / khyad par du srol rgyun ring ba'i btsun ma'i sgrub dgon la gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i dge mtshan dang khyad chos yod tshul sogs ngo sprod gnang yod/bzhi ba ltar na/ deng skabs khams ra'i yul gru'i khor yug kun tu bod brgyud nang bstan chos lugs rang dbang yod pa'i sgo nas dar spel byung yod par ma zad/ srid gzhung gi bdag skyong dang 'brel nas rig gnas slob gso dang sgyu rtsal 'khrab ston sogs sngar las yar rgyas dang / thon skyed dpal 'byor 'phel 3

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/rgyas su phyin pas mang tshogs kyi dngos po'i dpal yon dang bsam pa'i dpal yon sgo kun nas dar rgyas su 'gro bzhin yod tshul mtshams sbyor gnang yod/lnga ba ltar na/ khams ra sa khul 'di yongs su rgyal khab rim pa'i spyi gling dga' tshal chen mor gtan 'khel byas pa dang 'brel/chu bed dang / klog shugs/ nags skrun/ srog chags srung skyob bcas khor yug srung skyob dang spyi tshogs 'cham mthun can gyi gnas bab gsar ba chags par mi rnams nas 'bad brtson byed bzhin yod tshul mtshams sbyor mdzad yod pa bcas kyi khyad chos ldan pas/ bdag gi bsam par bod kyi gna' rabs lo rgyus dang /sa gnas lo rgyus la brtsad gcod dang zhib 'jug skor la ha cang nye bar mkho zhing klog mkhan rnams la kha gsal go bde yin pa'i khyad chos yod pa dang thos rgya dang bsam rgya je cher 'gro ba'i phan pa rgya chen po yod par snyam/zhes rgan sangs rgyas rin chen nas/2007 9 14

dkar chagamachod par brjod pa dang rtsom par dam bca' ba (1)le'u dang po/ a chung gnam rdzong gi gnas kyi rang bzhin brjod pa/(3)le'u gnyis pa/ bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs mdo tsam bshad pa/ (14)le'u gsum pa/ phyi dar bstan pa'i me ro bslangs tshul (19)le'u bzhi ba/ gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling gi byung ba brjod pa/ (38)le'u lnga ba/ bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/ (5⑨le'u drug pa/ bsam gtan 'phel rgyas gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/(79)le'u bdun pa/ gsar rnying ris med kyi mkhas grub mang bos bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad tshul/ (86)zhar byung / a chung gnam rdzong gi mchod gzhis lha sde skor rags tsam brjod pa/ (97)

mchod par brjod pa dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/mchod par brjod pa dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/༄gi /phyin drug bsdu bzhi'i rta bdun rtsal gyis bde chen chos dbyings mkha' ru drangs/ /'gog lam byang chub me yi khams las brgyad khri bzhi stong dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ /rig grol yon tan snang ba'i mdzod 'dzin tshogs gnyis zer ma 'bum du spro/ /mchog gsum rin chen pad+ma'i gnyen gyis sdug kun mun pa'i dpung tshogs choms/ /'dzam gling rig 'dzin stong gi spyi myes rang byung pad+ma ka ra dang / /marda sngags chos kyi sgron me sbar mdzad jo bo dpal ldan a ti sha/ rigs gsum 'dus pa'i gar kyi phung bo 'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa sogs/ /thugs rgyud gcig pa'i nges shes klong nas dad gsum lha phyag grangs su rtseg/ /spros bral zhi dbyings 'od gsal klong du gdod ma'i mgon por sku bzhengs kyang / /ma dag 'khor ba'i rigs drug yongs la rjes chags sprul ba'i rol gar gyis/ /srid zhi'i nags klung grangs med nyul ba'i rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma rnams/ /ji srid byang chub ma thob bar du gnas gsum mjes pa'i rgyan du bsten/ /rgyal kun gsang gsum 'dzum pa'i bcud len bde chen 'dren pa'i pho nya'i dpyid/ /srid zhi'i mtshar sdug gong bur smin pa'i ngag dbang dbyangs ldan 1

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/tshangs sras ma/ /stong ldan rgyud mang lhod kyis dkrol bzhin zur mig g.yo ba'i gar stabs bcas/ /bdag mgrin lha khyim yangs por byon dang ngag rig smra ba'i mchog sbyin mdzod/ /rang byung brag ni spya spyang dbyibs can gnum 'degs dz+wang gi phang ba ru/ /dmar gas gtsāng gsum mkhas grub rnams kyis blu med theg chen chos kyi mdzod/ /rgyal sras dgrongs pa ji bzhin bkral bas rnam mkhyen lam bzang rab gsal ba'i/ /ngo mtshar phyo rgyus brdun pa'i gtam tshogs lha sri nos phyo'i zol du rdung / 'on rkyong gnas mchog gong gi gsang gsum gyi/ /che las che ba rgya mchosare chab thigs tsam/ /rgyal sras dpa' bos brjod par mi nus na/ /bdaga'adras ngal ba brten pa ngo re gnongs/ /de lta na yang gnas mchog gang nyid kyi//rten dang brten pa'i dge mtshan ri mo 'bum/ /snyigs ma'i rdzun gyis bsub pa'i tshul mthong bas/ /kho bos las 'di ngal ba'i khur du len/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa lha'i me tog man+da ra ba'i phreng bas sngun bsus te gang gleng bar bya ba ni/ de la 'dir phyi dar bstan pa'i gnas mchog mdo smad a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus bshad pa la/ thog mar mchod par brjod pa dang rtsom par dam bca' ba/ bar du gzhung dngos le'u'i phreng ba bdun gyi rang bzhin du brjod pa/ mtha' mar zhar byung du gnubs khams ra gle lnga'i lo rgyus rags tsam brjod pa dang mjug gi gtam bcas so/ /2

le'u dang po/ a chung gnam rdzong gi gnas kyi rang bzhin brjod pa/le'u dang po/ a chung gnam rdzong gi gnas kyi rang bzhin brjod pa/de yang gangs dkar lhun po'i phreng ba tshar du dngar zhing 'phags mchog phyag na pad+ma'i thugs rje'i 'phrin las kyi rol rtse da phyogs su lhung ba'i bod kha ba can zhes bya ba'i zhing khyad par can 'di la/ chol kha gsum du phyes pa'i mnga' ris gung thang nas sog la skya bo yan chad dbus gtsang chos kyi chol kha/ de nas rma chu khugs pa yan chad mdo stod mi'i chol kha/ de nas rgya'i mchod rten dkar bo yan chad mdo smad rta'i chol khar bshad pa'i nang gses 'di la tsong kha bde khams su grags shing / de yang da lta'i zi ling phyogs kyi yul gru 'di la tsong kha dang / de'i lhag ma'i yul la tsong kha chen por 'bod pa'i yul gyi cha/ rigs gsum 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha ba chen po'i bla rir grags pa/rma rgyal sbom ra'i sras gsum pa skyes lha chen po'i pho brang rin chen rnam rgyal spungs pa'i lhun po tsong kha'i skyes ri gnyan po'i zhal lho ru gzigs pa'i mdun phyogs su brgyad ldan rma klung sgeg mo dal bu'i 'gros kyis spyi le1796la bskyod pa'i chu rgyun gyis lho byang gnyis su bgos pa'i lho rgyud/ rma klung g.yas su 'bab pa'i khugs 3

ma chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/pa'i 'gram rgyud na/ mdo smad grub pa'i gnas chen yongs kyi phyi mo/sngon glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs tshe/ bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum ste/ dmar g.yo gtsang gsum dang lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje sogs phebs nas bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal sogs bslab pa'i gnas la bkod de/ phyi dar bstan pa'i me ro bslangs pa'i rtsod med kyi gnas mchog mdo smad rdzong chen gsum gyi ya gyal a chung gnam rdzong zhes mtshan snyan gyi rol mo mdo dbus khams gsum du grags pa 'di nyid ma bcos rang byung lhun chags su gnas yod/ gnas 'di yod sa ni da lta'i skad kyis bshad na/mtsho sngon zhing chen rma lho khul gcan tsha rdzong khams ra grong rdal gyi mnga' khongs su chags yod la/ gnas 'di'i mtha' skor du phyi nang gsang gsum gyi lcags ri'i tshul gyis dgon sde grags can dang / gnas ri byin can/ rten 'gangs chen sogs kyis brgyan yod pa'i phyi'i rim pa shar gyi phyogs na/ byang gi dgon chen bzhi'i ya gyal zhwa ser bstan pa'i 'byung khungs bya khyung dgon pa chags yod/ lho yi phyogs na yul 'di'i rdzo ri mtho shos mtsho ngos las spyi khru4614lhag yod pa'i srin po dpal ldan don 'grub dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gnyen du mtho zhing brjid/ nub kyi phyogs na byin rlabs thub dbang dngos dang mnyam pa'i mdo smad jo'u chen bzhi'i nang tshan khri ka'i jo bo skye rgu'i bsod nams kyi zhing du 4

le'u dang po/ a chung gnam rdzong gi gnas kyi rang bzhin brjod pa/bzhugs yod/ byang gi phyogs na ma/do smad kyi ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta gsum gyi ya gyal zhwa dmar paṇ+ḍi ta'i gdan sa chen mo dhī tsha bkra shis chos sdings bzhugs yod/ de nas nang gi rim par mkhas pa dang grub pa/ bya btang ba dang / sgom chen pa/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ba sogs mngon pa dang mi mngon pa'i tshul gyis phebs bzhugs gnang myong ba'i khams ra'i rdzong chen bco brgyad dang rdzong phran du mas mtha' nas bskor yod/ khyad par rdzong chen bco brgyad ni stod na dkar bo lha yi rdzong drug gi rdzong dpon rgod po rdzong la/'khor du gnas spo rdzong / ba shing rdzong / khra mchu rdzong / jo mo rdzong /rnga rdzong bcas drug dang / bar na dmar bo btsan gyi rdzong drug gi rdzong dpon ra gzhi'i rdzong la/ 'khor du mgon po rdzong / lam 'phrang rdzong / rta rdzong / sde brgyad rdzong / 'ug rdzong bcas drug dang / smad na sngon mo klu yi rdzong drug gi rdzong dpon smug po rdzong la/'khor du la ring rdzong / nor rdzong / lug rdzong / ser mo rdzong /zor rdzong bcas drug ste bsdoms pa'i bco brgyad du bgrang ba'i lugs gcig dang / yang brtsi lugs gzhan zhig las/ dkar bo lha yi rdzong drug ni/ gnas spo rdzong / rgod po rdzong / ba shing rke rdzong /khra mchu rdzong / jo mo rdzong / rta rdzong / dmar bo btsan gyi rjong drug ni/ ra gzhi rdzong / mgon po rdzong / gnam rdzong / sde brgyad rdzong /brag dmar seng ge rdzong / 'ug rdzong / sngon mo klu yi rdzong drug ni/5

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/smug rdzong / nor rdzong / ser mo rdzong / shwa rdzong / ra rdzong / zor rdzong bcas lha btsan klu gsum gyi rdzong chen bco brgyad gtso byas rdzong phran mang bos mu khyud du bskor yod/ de nas gsang ba'i rim pa shar gyi phyogs na 'ug rdzong ste/ lha lung dpal rdor gyi sgrub phug dang de'i klad kyi brag ldebs su mchod rten cha brgyad rang byon kun gyi mngon sum mig gi spyod yul du son thub/ lho yi phyogs na mgon po rdzong ste/ sngon ko'u ba chos rgya mtshos mgon po sgrub nas zhal gzigs mthong ba'i gnas ri byin can dang / nub kyi phyogs na khra mchu rdzong ste/ sngon slob dpon chen pos khams kyi seng brag nas ma sangs 'gengs pa dam la bzhag par gsungs pa'i yul 'di'i bstan srung mthu bo che ma sangs rgyal bo'i lha tho brtsigs pa'i gnas ri gnyan po zhig yin par grags/ byang du sde brgyad rdzong ste/lha klu sde brgyad tshogs kyis yul 'di'i bstan 'gro kun la sri zhu sgrub cing / dgyes pa'i yo lang gi bro gar 'khrab pa'i gnas ri sum rtsen bu mo gar nyams kyis 'gying ba lta bu bcas sgo srung rdzong lha bzhis mtha' nas mu 'brel du bskor yod/ de ltar dbus ri dben byung nam mkha' rdzong gi rtse mor rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i dbyibs mtshon pa'i sul gsum dang / rwa gdengs pa'i 'bur gsum bcas gsal bar dod pas na rtse mo rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i rdzong zhes grags pa dang / zhing skyong dur khrod lha mo rdzong zhes grags pa'i 6

le'u dang po/ a chung gnam rdzong gi gnas kyi rang bzhin brjod pa/bshad rgyun yang 'dug la rdzong 'di'i rtse na mkhas pa mi gsum gyi sgrub phug yod cing / rdzong rked na mkhas ba mi gsum gyi bla sdong yod/ 'dir yongs grags su a chung gnam rdzong zhes pa'i gnas rdzong 'di'i rtser 'gro dgos tshe byang gi rkang lam phra mo gcig ma gtogs med la/ de yang shin tu gsang rgya bsdams pa dang mtshungs par mi phal mo ches mi tshor ba dang / sgrib byed kyi yol ba lta bur bod yig a chung gi(ladabyibs can brag rang byon 'bur du thon nas sgo bcad yod pa'i ri der bltas nas a chung dang /dben byung nam mkha' rdzong 'di'i mtho tshad la spyi khru2600lhag yod cing / gnas ri 'di mtho zhing brjid la rtse mo gnam du zug pa lta bu'i rdzong zhig yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis a chung gnam rdzong zhes rjes grub kyi ming thogs/ yang mkhas pa la las an chung dang / 'a chung / zhes 'bri lugs 'dug kyang / 'dir ming gi tha snyad sbyor gzhi brag('a)yig gi dbyibs la ltos gzhi bcos nas ltos 'jog gis grub pa'i a chen gyi yi ge(snyi'adi bris na shin tu legs par snyam/ de lta bu'i gnas 'di nas bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams srung ba'i gnas kyi khyad chos dag ma tshang ba med de/ (khams ra'i lo rgyus tshigs bcad ma tamyu ra'i sgra dbyangagalas/ tha mal dgra las rgyal phyir btsan pa'i rdzong / /bcos dang rang bzhin grub pa mang mchis mod/ bstan pa'i dgra 7

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/las bstan dang bstan 'dzin tshogs/ rnam par rgyal ba'i rdzong chen 'di las gang / /bstan rtsa so sor thar ba'i tsan+dan ljon/bstan dgra glang dar lce gnyis bskyod gang gis/ /bstan srog ming gi lhag mar byed nye tshe/ /bstan pa phyi dar dri bsung gnas 'dir spros / zhes dang / 'phags pa'i yul dang gangs ljongs gzhan rnams su/ /rgyal bstan dar ba'i gnas chen grangs mang yang /bstan pa gnas kyis srung zhing gnas gang gis/ /nyams pa gso ba'i gnas mchog 'di las gang / /zhes bsngags pa ltar/ sngon glang dar mas 'dul ba'i bstan pa yongs su bsnubs tshe dpal chu bo ri'i sgom grwa nas dmar g.yo gtsang gsum gnas 'dir bros byol tu phebs pa dang / lha lung dpal rdor gyis glang dar ma bgrongs rjes gnas 'dir khong rnam pa lhan 'dzoms byung nas/phyi nang dgra rigs kyis gnod pa mi tshugs pa'i btsan rdzong khyad par can 'di nas yun ring bzhugs shing / bla chen po dang dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa sogs la bslab pa bstsal zhing phyi dar bstan pa'i me ro gsos pa'i phyir/ (khams ra'i lo rgyus tshiṭa bcad ma tasbu ra'i sgra dbyangagalas/ /gangs can ljongs 'dir bstan pa snga phyi ru/ /dar ba'i bstan gnyis dpal gyi bsam yas dang / /mdo smad a chung gnam rdzong gang dag las/ /gzhan du yod dam gzu bor gnas pa rnams/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bod du bstan pa snga 8

le'u dang po/ a chung gnam rdzong gi gnas kyi rang bzhin brjod pa/dar gyi skabs dpal gyi bsam yas nas dar ba dang / phyi dar gyi skabs a chung gnam rdzong gtsor gyur ba'i rma klung rdo rje brag ra dang / tan tig sogs nas dar ba yin zhes pa'i ngag rgyun yod pa rnams don dngos dang mthun pa yin tshul da lta'ang dngos su mthong rgyu yod pa'i gna' ba'i mkhar shul dang dgon shul sogs las ra 'phrod byung thub ste/ de yang gnam rdzong khor yug tu gtogs pa'i sgrub sde rnams ni/ de'u gong sde ba'i sgar chags sna zhes par sde 'di ma chags pa'i yar sngon nas dgon pa zhig yod pa'i ngag rgyun dang / sa der gyo mag rnying ba dag sa 'og nas byung ste dgon pa'i chags shul gsal bor yod pa/ ra gzhi rdzong gi lung ba'i 'dabs su'ang sgar chags sna kha zer ba'i dgon ming yod pa der sngon chad dgon pa chags pa'i shul kha da lta'ang dngos su mthong rgyu yod/ a mdzes sde ba'i la kha'i shar na khri ka'i bis kyā chung bas phyag btab mdzad pa'i nags par dgon zhes bya ba zhig kyang yod/ yang rnga rdzong na dgon pa zhig yod pa'i shul du da lta khams ra nags las khang chags yod/ gna' dus gnam rdzong nye 'dabs kyi byang phyogs thang chen du/ dpal ldan sa skya tā 'on pa'i sgrub dgon chags yod pa sngags rams pa ye shes bsam 'grub kyi rnam thar du gsal/ phyis su rgyu rkyen gang yin ma nges mod 'du khang ma zhig par steng du sa spungs mdzad yod pa da lta sgang 'bur 9

spochung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/gyi rnam pa tsam las mi mthong / sngon lha khang yod pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas da lta lha khang mthil zhes grags shing / dur khrod bsil ba tshal dang mtshungs pa'i gnas kyang zer/ gnam rdzong rtse'i brag nor bu'i gsham du dgon rnying zer ba zhig yod pa der sngon rma chu byang rgyud kyi gnubs ban gro brag nang gi rdzong tog dgon pa zer ba de 'dir gnas spor yong nas gcig tu bsres pa yin la 'di dang gong gi a mdzes la kha'i shar gyi dgon pa gnyis rjes su bkra shis rnam rgyal gling dang gzhi gcig tu bsres pa'i lo rgyus yod/ da lta bzhugs pa'i dgon sde khag ni/ bkra shis thang du zhwa ser rang lugs 'dzin pa'i dgon te bkra shis rnam rgyal gling dang / rnam thar thang du snga 'gyur rnying ma'i dgon gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling / mchod rten thang du rnying ma btsun ma'i dgon bsam gtan 'phel rgyas gling bcas lhar bcas 'gro ba'i mchod sdong gcig pur bzhugs yod pa so so'i lo rgyus 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur/ de ltar gnas kyi snying bo a chung gnam rdzong dang khams ra gle lnga'i bkod pa'i gzhi'i rgya khyon la spyi le gru bzhi ma152 5lhag dang /yul 'di'i ches mtho shos mtsho ngos las smi3 100tsam gyis mtho zhing / ches dma' shos smi2 300yin/ sa'i go la'i gzhung thig tu'u36dang cha shas4nas tu'u36dang cha shas10bar dang /'phred thig tu'u101dang cha shas38nas tu'u101dang cha 10

le'u dang po/ma chung gnam rdzong gi gnas kyi rang bzhin brjod pa/shas49steng du gnas yod/ lo re'i ches mtho ba'i drod tshad20dang / ches dma' ba'i drod tshad11yin/ lo re'i cha snyoms drod tshad6nas29bar yin la char chu 'bab tshad ha'o smi450nas490bar yin/ yul ljongs 'di'i sa cha'i brgya cha'i brgyad cu rang byung gi brag ri dang nags tshal gyis khyab yod/ ri brag thams cad dmar bo zangs kyi mdog dang byi ru'i mdangs ltar mchod rten gyi dbyibs dang / dung dkar gyi gzugs/gdugs dang rgyal mtshan/ 'a chung gi dbyibs/ la la ni mkha' 'gros tshogs 'khor bskor ba dang 'dra zhing / la la ni rgyal ba'i pho brang dang / chos kyi po ti brtsigs pa 'dra ba'i ngo mtshar zhing yid kyi dang ba 'dren pa'i rdzong chen bco brgyad dang rdzong phran mang po yod cing / de'i bar gseng kun tu 'thung na lto dang mgrin par bde ba'i dwangs gtsang gi chu phran thams cad lhung lhung gar gyis 'gyu zhing / gser bya de pho dang / ri skegs/ lha bya gong mo/bye'u co ga dang 'jol mo/ skya ka khra mo dang khu byug la sogs pa'i bya rigs mang bos mgrin pa'i rnga chung gi gdangs dbyangs lhod kyis 'byin zhing / g.yu mdog gi lo mas bsil yab thab cing yal 'dab kyi lag rdang dam du sbrel ba'i lha shing shug pa dang / thang shing / gsom dkar/ stag pa/ dbyar ba/ yo 'bog stag ma/'phang ma/ spen ma/ mdzo mo nu shing / star bu/ kalco ka ri/ ri skyes 11

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/ar nag rtswa pad+ma sogs sngo ljang rkang 'thung gi rigs nyis brgya lhag dang / rtswa sman dang sngo sman/ me tog sna brgya sogs kyi mdzes sdug gi khengs pa mtho zhing / dri bsung gi spos ngad ldang ba/ de'i khrod bag yangs su rtsen pa'i ri dwags shwa ba dang / gla ba/ rna/dgo ba/ ri bong sogs ri skyes srog chags mang bos 'tshe ba'i dogs snang med par spro dga'i bang rtsal 'gran no/ de lta bu'i srid zhi'i mdzes sdug gi nying bcud yod do cog 'jig rten byed pos ched du bkod pa 'dra ba'i gnas mchog 'dir/ dus bzhi'i dbye ba gsal zhing / nyi 'od dro grang snyoms pa/ bser bu'i rgyu phyogs bzang zhing kha dbugs gtsang ba/ 'du 'dzis dben zhing bag phebs pa la sogs pa'i ngo mtshar ba'i khyad chos 'bum gyis phyug yod pas/ ji skad du/ dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang / /bung ba'i tshogs rnams sprin bzhin 'dus/ /zhes pa ltar/ gnas mchog gang gi byin rlabs kyi mtshan snyan dron mo dang mdzes sdug gi bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal yon gyis tshe blos btang gi bya btang ba dang / gnas nges med 'grim pa'i rnal 'byor ba/ grub pa ba/mkhas pa/ sbas tshul can sogs mngon pa dang mi mngon pa'i tshul gyis gnas 'dir zam ma chad par phebs pa dang / rang re'i zhing chen gtso byas rgyal khab phyi nang nas phebs pa'i lta skor ba sogs lo re nas lo rer je mang du 'gro bzhin yod do/ /12

le'u dang po/ a chung gnam rdzong gi gnas kyi rang bzhin brjod pa/smras ba/ li khri'i sa 'dzin bye ba'i dbus su drug sde'i gsal byed gsum pa'i gzugs/ /rang byung mtshan ma'i brag skyibs phang bar bstan pa'i srog zungs slar yang byin/ /khor yug rkang 'thung dpag tshad bsgyings shing dag byed g.yu 'brug sa la rtsen/ /mkha' 'gro stong gi drug skyes glu yis srid zhi'i mgron po gnas 'dir 'gug /

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/le'u gnyis pa/ bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs mdo tsam brjod pa/de yang mnyam med thub pa'i dbang bos lung gis zin cing /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang / bka' gdams glegs bam sogs na mi 'gyur rdo rje'i lung tshig gis ches cher bsngags pa'i zhing dam pa/'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo'i gdul zhing gangs can bsil mo ljongs 'dir/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa snga phyi gnyis su dar ba las thog ma'i bstan pa dar ba'i gnas ni/ bod chol kha gsum du phyes pa'i dbus gtsang chos kyi zhing gi bod rgyal thog ma gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung rgyal rabs nyer bdun gyi ring la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i ming tsam yang ma byung / de nas 'phags pa kun tu bzang bo'i rnam 'phrul lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi ring la/ nam mkha' nas gser gyi mchod rten khru gang ba/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo/ dpang skong phyag rgya ba/ snying bo yi ge drug pa/ cirnya ma ṇi'i skos phor/ mu tra'i phyag rgya rnams nyi ma'i 'od zer dang 'grogs nas pho brang yum bu bla sgang gi rtser babs pa dang / da lta'i gdung rabs lnga na 'di'i don shes pa 'byung ngo zhes nam mkha' nas sgra byung ngo / /de rgyal bos kha phyes pas chos dang bon gang yin ma 14

le'u gnyis pa/bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs mdo tsam brjod pa/mkhyen yang / ngo mtshar bar gzigs nas rin po che'i khri la bzhag mtshan la gnyan po gsang ba zhes bya bar btags nas 'khor dang bcas pas phyag 'tshal/ mtshan mo mar me phul/ nyin re bzhin gser skyems dang / g.yu sngon gyis mchod pa byas shing bod yul du gsung rab byung ste bstan pa'i dbu brnyes pa yin/ de nas spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul ba srong btsan sgam po'i sku ring la/thon mi rgya gar du mngags nas yi ge'i srol btod/ mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug gi khrims bcos/ dmar bo rir pho brang brtsigs/mtha' bzhi'i rgyal bo dbang du bsdus/ bal bza' khri btsun dang rgya bza' kong jo gnyis khab tu bzhes nas ra sa 'phrul snang dang ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ jo bo shākya rnam gnyis bod la spyan drangs nas sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi rten btsugs/ lo tsā ba mang bo spyan drangs nas mdo sde pad+ma dkar bo/ dkon cog sprin/gzungs cin dha ma ṇi/ 'dus ba rin po che'i tog gzungs dral lnga la sogs bsgyur nas chos dkon cog gi rten btsugs/ dge 'dun dkon cog gi rten chos nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag la ming mkhan po dang jo bor gnang nas bslab pa gsum la bkod/lung rigs man ngag gi chos mang du spel/ gzhan yang rgya yig snyan ngag deb sum brgya/ 'jig rten bslabs pa'i legs bshad deb bcu/ nad rigs gso bcos kyi sman sbyor khag nyis brgya lnga bcu/15

ma chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/bzo rigs sna kha drug cu/ skar rtsis dang sa gshis bya ba'i deb sna mang bo/ 'debs 'dzugs sa bon rnam grangs/ ar las rtsig bzo'i bkod ston pa sogs bod la nang 'dren byas nas bod 'bangs sems can thams cad chos srid gnyis kyis bskyangs/ de nas 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul ba khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la mkhan chen bornyi sa twa dang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs te sa gzhi dang lha 'dre gdug pa can thams cad btul/ dpal bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa bzhengs shing rgya gar nag dang / bal bo sogs nas mkhas ba mang po spyan drangs nas lo tsā ba snga tshar gsum dang / bar tshar gsum/ phyi tshar gsum sogs kyis lo tsā byas nas sde snod gsum dang / gsang sngags kyi chos mang bo rgya gar du ma lus ba tsam zhig bod du bsgyur nas chos dkon mchog gi rten btsugs/ dge 'dun dkon mchog gi rten du sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung / de nas dad pa can dang shes rab can mang bo rab tu byung / chos kyi bshad grwa dang sgom grwa mang bo btsugs nas chos 'chad nyan sogs shin tu dar ches bas bod kyi bstan pa 'dra rgya gar du yang ma byung ba yin/ phyag na rdo rje'i sprul ba mnga' bdag khri ral ba can gyi sku ring la pho brang 'on cang rdo rgya phibs dgu thog ma bzhengs/ btsun mo cog ro bza' dpal gyi ngang tshul la sogs btsun mo che chung lnga khab tu bzhes/16

le'u gnyis pa/bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs mdo tsam brjod pa/dge ba bcu'i khrims bzung / rgya gar gyi parnyi ta dzi na mi tra dang /shī len+d+ra bo rnyi/ dā na shrī la la sogs pa spyan drangs/ lo tsā ba ska cog zhang gsum bcas kyis chos bsgyur te/ sngon gyi chos thams cad skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ bkas rnam pa gsum du mdzad de/ sde ba bye brag tu gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba las gzhan dang gsang sngags rnams ma bsgyur cig ces bkas bcad do/ tha na bre dang / srang dang / zho la sogs pa'ang rgya gar dang mthun par bcas/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgom grwa btsugs/'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bshad grwa btsugs/ chos sde sum cu tham par dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi 'dus grwa btsugs/ rab byung ba re re'i zhabs tog la khyim mi bdun re phul/ dbu thod la dar btags te gdan du 'ding /zhabs spyi bor len no/ bson nams kyi stobs kyis rgya nag po tshun chad dbang du bsdus te/ mnga' thang shin tu che/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la bkur bste bla na med pa mdzad pas sdig blon rnams yid ma rangs par lkog nas chos khrims bshigs te bar chad byas/ lha sras gtsang ma sgyugs/ btsun mo ngang tshul ma dang ban+de chen po dpal gyi yon tan gnyis kyis nal bshams so zhes phra ma bcug ste/ ban de chen po bkum/ btsun mo lcebs/ btsan po dgung lo so drug pa lcags mo bya la dbas rgyal to re dang / co ro 17

spochung sam rdzong gi lo galegs sgra gnyis kyis zhal ltag par bstan te bkrongs so/ /smras ba/ ke la sha yis mu khyud bcings pa'i bod yul mun pa'i smag klong du/ /chos rgyal lo paṇa na rim phreng ba'i legs byas stong gi 'od srungs kyis/ /mdo sngags rgyal bstan bcu gnyis bdag po gangs can mkha' ru legs drangs pas/ /rgud pa'i mun tshogs dbyings su dag cing chos srid snang bas mtha' bzhi gsal//18

le'u gsum pa/ phyi dar bstan pa'i me ro bslangs tshul/le'u gsum pa/ phyi dar bstan pa'i me ro bslangs tshul/de nas me mkha' rgya mtsho 'das lo278pa/ lcags bya901lor glang dar ma khrid 'khod nas dang po rgyun ltar rgyal srid bskyangs shing / de nas gangs ri'i ljongs kyi 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi mthu dman pa dang / khyad par du bdud rgyal glang dar ma'i sngon gyi log smon dus su smin nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs pa'i tshul brjod na/ sngon de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srungs kyi bstan pa la/ bal yul ma gu ta'i yul gru ru/ bya rdzi ma bde mchog ma zhes bya ba'i dbul mo zhig la pha mi gcig pa'i bu bzhi skyes/ dang po rta rdzi'i bu skyes/ de 'og phag rdzi'i bu skyes/ de 'og khyi rdzi'i bu skyes/ de 'og bya rdzi'i bu skyes/ de nas mas bya btsos pa'i gla bsags pas bu bzhi yang khyim pa rab thang du phogaslar yang gla mang bo bsags te/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi rten 'gro ba dpag tu med pa'i bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying bo can gyi mchod rten zhig bzhengs snyam nas yul gyi rgyal bo la zhu 'bul byas pas/ de ltar bya rung gsungs/ de nas dbul mo bya rdzi ma dang / bu bzhi/19

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/bran gcig rnams kyis glang bo che gcig dang bong bu gcig yod pa la so phag bkal zhing bskyal te/ mchod rten chen po'i rmang bting ste dbyar dgun ma chad par brtsigs pas lo bzhi'i ring bum pa man brtsigs grub byung / de nas bya rdzi ma bde mchog ma de nyid tshe dus byed par shes te/ bu bzhi g.yog dang lnga la mchod rten chen po legs 'grub 'byung dgos shing / nang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel bzhugs su gsol te/ rab tu gnas pa rgya chen po gyis shig ces smras te che'i dus byas so/ de nas bu rnams kyis ma'i kha chems dang drin lan bso pa'i phyir/ sngar ltar brtson 'grus bskyed de lo gsum la brtsigs pas/ mchod rten chen po legs grub byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srungs kyi ring bsrel ma ga dha'i bre gang srog shing gi nang du bzhugs su gsol te/mchod pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa bshams te rab tu gnas pa'i me tog 'thor ba'i tshe/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i khams thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa 'od srungs 'khor dang bcas pa dang /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dgra bcom dpag tu med pas bskor ba dang / gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ rigs gsum mgon po zhi khro'i lha tshogs grangs med pa byon nas/ me tog 'thor zhing bkra shis rgya chen po mdzad de/ thams cad kyi zhal nas mgrin gcig 20 mo

le'u gsum pa/ phyi dar bstan pa'i me ro bslangs tshul/dang dbyangs gcig gis/ kye skal ba mchog dang ldan pa'i rigs kyi bu khyed rnams kyis nyon cig khyed rnams kyis lhag bsam rnam par dag pas dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi sku'i rten mchog tu gyur pa'i mchod rten chen po 'di lta bu bzhengs pa'i phan yon gyis/ rang rang gi smon lam ci btab pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur bas thob cig ces bka' bstsal byung bas/ bu che ba rta rdzi'i bsam pa la/ da lta byang gi phyogs kyi rgyal khams 'di na/ 'a/rmig pa shā/rmig yul mtha' 'khob ces bya ba/ ri thams cad gangs su yod pa/ mthil thams cad chu ru yod pa/ dbyar chu bya mang bo gnas pa/ dgun 'khyag pa'i thang gcig tu gnas pa zhig yod pa de/ ma 'ongs ba na chu thams cad bskams te/ shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi gdul zhing du 'gyur nas/ der sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan 'dug pas/ de'i dus bdag shākya thub pa'i bstan pa la 'khyag sa 'khyag yul gyi mtha' 'khob der chos skyong ba'i rgyal bo chen po gcig tu skyes nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'dzugs par shog cig ces smon lam btab bo/ de 'og phag rdzi'i bus/ phu bo khyed chos skyong pa'i rgyal bor skyes nas sangs kyi bstan pa 'dzugs pa'i dus su/ bdag ni bstan pa'i 21

ma chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/gzhi ma dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs pa'i dge slong rnam par dag pa gcig tu skyes nas/ dge 'dun thams cad rab tu byung bar byed pa'i mkhan po gcig tu skyes bar shog cig ces brjod do/ de 'og khyi rdzi'i bus phu bo khyed gnyis 'khyag pa 'khyag yul gyi mtha' 'khob tu/ gcig gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzugs/ gcig gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i dus su/ bdag pad+ma'i sdong bo las brdzus te skyes ba/ skye shi'i rgyun bcad de tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa/ nus pas lha 'dre mi gsum 'dul ba gcig tu skyes nas mtha' 'khob de nyid kyi 'dre srin gdug pa can thams cad 'dul ba dang / khyed gnyis kyi bsam pa 'grub cing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mtha' dag srung ba'i sngags 'chang nus pa can gcig tu skye bar shog cig ces btab bo/ de 'og bya rdzi'i bu'i smon lam ni/ phu bo khyed gsum 'khyag pa 'khyag yul gyi mtha' 'khob tu/ gcig gis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa btsugs/ gcig gis 'dzin/ gcig gis srung ba'i dus su/ bdag khyed rnams mjal phrad byed pa'i 'phrin blon gcig tu skyes par shog ces btab bo/ /de'i tshe bong bu de'i bsam pa la nga la yang smon lam zhig 'debs te 'ong bsam pa la/ smon lam ci yang 'debs pa ma byung bas/ kho khros nas kho rgyal bor skyes nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'dzugs pa'i dus der/ bdag chos la mi dga' ba'i bka' blon zhig tu skyes 22

le'u gsum pa/ phyi dar bstan pa'i me ro bslangs tshul/nas rgyal bo kho la ci yang bya dbang med pa gcig tu skye bar shog cig ces byas so/ de skad brjod pa g.yog pos thos pas/ kho de'i lta bu'i bdud blon du skyes nas chos la bar chad byed pa'i dus/de nyid kyi g.yo thabs dang nus pa thams cad bzlog cing 'joms par byed pa'i chos blon thabs la mkhas pa zhig tu bdag skye bar shog cig ces smon lam btab bo/ /yang glang bo che de'i bsam pa la'ang / nga la yang smon lam zhig 'debs te 'ong bsam pa la/smon lam ci yang ma btab pas/ kho khros nas ngas sa rdo 'di tsam bskyal bas smon lam ci yang mi 'debs na/ khong rnams kyis btsugs pa'i bstan pa de'i rgyal bo'i bu'am tsha bor skyes te ngas bsnubs par shog cig ces byas so/ de skad brjod pa bya rog gcig gis tshor bas lhag pa'i bsam pa skyes te/ kho de lta bu'i rgyal bor skyes nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsnubs pa'i dus/bdag byang chub sems dpa' chen po gcig tu skyes nas bdud kyi rgyal bo de nyid gsod par shog cig ces smon lam btab bo/ de ltar smon lam btab tshad ma lus grub pa ni/ de'i tshe de'i dus kyi bu che ba rta rdzi'i bus rgyal bor skye bar smon lam btab pa ni chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan yin/ de'i dus phag rdzi'i bus mkhan por skye bar smon lam btab pa ni mkhan po bornyi sa twa yin/ de'i dus khyi rdzi bus sngags 'chang du skye bar smon lam btab pa ni slob dpon 23

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ de'i dus bya rdzi'i bus 'phrin blon du skye bar smon lam btab pa ni yar lungs kyi sba mi khri gzher yin/de'i dus bong bus smon lam log ste bdud blon du skye bar smon lam btab pa ni bdud blon ma zhang khron pa skyes yin/ de'i dus g.yog gis bdud blon 'joms pa'i chos blon du skye bar smon lam btab pa ni/ chos blon 'gos pad+ma gung btsan yin/ de'i dus glang bo ches smon lam log ste bdud kyi rgyal bor skyes nas bstan pa bsnub par smon lam btab pa ni rgyal bo glang dar ma u dum btsan po yin/ de'i dus bya rog gis sems bskyed nas bdud kyi rgyal bo de nyid gsod par smon lam btab pa ni lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yin/ de ltar mchod rten chen po bya rung kha shor brtsigs pa'i phan yon gyis smon lam bzang ngan thams cad chud mi 'dza' bar grub pa'i phyir/ rgyal bo glang dar ma de nyid chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyi tsha bor skyes nas/ chung dus nas shes rgya chung la zhe gyong zhing / chos srid kyi go rtogs dang 'bangs skyong gi thabs shes med par/ mang tshogs la bsam yul lase brgal ba'i bka' khrims lci ba phab ste/ rgyal ba'i bang so 'bru ba dang / yul gyi dgon sde bshig pa/ rin thang gzhal du med pa'i rig gnas kyi dngos po dang / rten gsum gtor brlag byas shing / rab tu byung ba kun phab/ btsun pa'i rtags bor du ma 'dod pa rnams la 24 —

le'u gsum pa/ phyi dar bstan pa'i me ro bslangs tshul/mda' gzhu rnga gshang bskur nas rngon par btang / mi nyan pa rnams bsad/ lha shākya mu ne bsgul ma nus pas bye thems su bcug sgo brtsigs te btsun pa chang 'thung ba'i ri mo bris/ bsam yas dang / ra mo che'i sgo la 'dag zhal byas/ po ti phal cher lha sa'i brag la sbas/ parnyi ta la la sgyugs/ la la yul du bskrad/ lo tsā ba phal cher bros/ gshed ma bkye ste nyang ting 'dzin bzang bo dang /rma rin chen mchog bsad pas man ngag gi rgyun chad/ 'byo khri gsum rje bsad pas dkor nor gyi khungs bsubs/ rgya gar nas parnyi ta kha bkag pas nub phyogs bdud rtsi'i rgyun chad/ shar phyogs kyi gser zam ser po chur bskur pas rgya nag nas nor gyi tshong sgo bcad/ yab mes gong ma'i thugs dam la gshe zhing skur 'debs sogs bod yul du ya nga ba'i 'pho 'gyur las 'gul bslangs/ de nas me stag906lor yer ba'i lha ri snying bo na lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes sgom sgrub byed kyin yod pa'i tshe/ nub gcig dpal ldan lha mo byung nas/ rgyal po glang dar ma gsod pa'i dus la bab po/ skrag mi dgos/ kho mos grogs bya'o zhes bskul bar brten/ sang nyin nye gnas la rgyu mtshan dris pas/ bden par 'dug rgyal po la snying rje khyad par can skyes te/ rta dkar po la sol ba'i bye mas byugs/ ber phyi nag pa nang dkar ba byas te gyon/ mgo la zhwa nag po gyon/ gdong la sol snum byugs/ phu thung 25

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/du mda' gzhu bcug rta nag po la zhon te lha sar phyin pa dang /rgyal bos rdo ring gi yi ger gzigs kyin 'dug pa'i drung du phyag byed pa ltar byas nas/ phyag dang po la gzhu bdungs/ gnyis pa la mda' ltong sbyar/ gsum pa la mthel bkrol te btang bas brang la phog ste btsan po bkrongs so/ nga bdud ya bzher nag po yin/rgyal bo sdig can gsod na de ltar gsod pa yin zer nas bros/ra mdas rjes nas bsnyegs pas/ mi nag rta nag gtsang bor brgal bas dkar po gyur/ ber phyi nang ldog ste gon/ nga lha gnam the'u dkar bo bya ba yin zer nas bros so/ skabs der/ dge 'dun gyi 'tsho ba sogs bla nas sbyor ba med pas dpal chu bo ri'i sgom grwa nas bros byol byed par brtsams te/ bod kyi mkhas ba mi gsum ste stod lung gi dmar shākya mu ne dang / bo dong ba g.yo dge 'byung / rgya rab pa'i gtsang rab gsal bcas kyis khong rnam pa gsum po'i dngos kyi slob dpon cog ro klu'i rgyal mtshan gyis bsgyur ba'i 'dul ba'i las chog karma shā tam gyi dpe chas gtsos po ti dre'u khal gcig bkal nas mnga' ris stod du bros/ der sdod ma tshugs par gar log gi yul du song / lo tsā ba med pas 'gro don ma byung / de nas mdo smad du 'gro ba la hor yul bskor nas e rod brgyud de phebs pa yin/ der dge bsnyen shākya shes rab la brten te re zhig bzhugs kyang skad rigs ma gcig stabs 26

le'u gsum pa/ phyi dar bstan pa'i me ro bslangs tshul/chos kyi bya ba byed ma nus pas/ mdo smad du phebs pa'i thog mar a rig gi yul be ru tshwa mtsho nas byon te rma klung rdo rje brag du byon mod/ de'i dus bod rgyal bo'i mnga' dbang btsan pas khong rnam gsum gsang ba thub pa'i gnas shig dgos phyir/ gnam rdzong gnas btsan par gzigs nas gsang rgya can gyi gnas der phebs/ 'dir phebs pa'i dus ni me mkha' rgya mtsho 'das lo280rtsa stod cig dang / spyi lo905yas mas tsam yin par mngon/ skabs der lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yang bod rgyal sa'i mkha' mtha' nyul te rgya bod kyi sa mtshams su gsang ba thub par dgongs te lo rdo rje brag tu phebs/ sa de'i ming dris pas/ rma klung rdo rje brag ra zer zhus pas gsang ba thub pa'i rten 'brel gyi mtshan mar gzigs nas/ sgrub phug tu sgom sgrub bskyangs shing mdun thang du lcags kyi mda' gzhu gter du sbas/ mkhas ba mi gsum gnam rdzong du gtan bzhugs byas rjes yul mi 'ga' res tshor te/ ser mo ba gsum gzhan zhig nas byon te 'di phyogs rdza lung zhig tu gsang bar bzhugs yod pa'i gtam dpal gyi rdo rjes gsan nas/ phyogs du mar btsal rjes mkhas ba mi gsum gzhan zhig tu phebs nas phyir gnam rdzong la phebs pa'i rjes bsnyegs/gnam rdzong lung ba'i 'dabs kyi bkra shis chu mgor tsha babs gnang nas phebs ma thag pa'i shul du bslebs te/ myur bar khong 27

mchungaganardardzongagilorgyus/rnam pa gsum gyi sku rjes ded/ gnam rdzong rtser phebs pa'i brag nor ba'i gsham du sku rjes chod de phan tshun zhib rjes kyis gleng ༄mol mdzad/ de dus mkhas pa mi gsum gong nas rim par bzhugs te ngal gso mdzad pa'i shul du phyis su thang shing sdong bo gsum skyes pa nga brgyad skabs su bcad/ de dus lha lung dpal rdor rang nyid rgyal bo bkrong pa'i sdig can dang dme can du bltas nas cung rgyang ring du bsdad nas zhu ba mdzad pa'i shul du 'bum khang dang ma ṇi rdo spungs rjes dran du bkod yod/ de nas bzung lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes mkhas pa mi gsum gyi sku srung mdzad phyir gnam rdzong rtse'i mkhas pa mi gsum gyi sgrub phug mthong ba'i shar phyogs 'ug rdzong stangs pa'i sha ma lung ba'i brag phug tu rgyun bzhugs gnang / de'i klad du mchod rten rang byon/ mdun du ma mo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i shing sdong rkang gcig lho na mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i brag dmar rang byon/ byang na nya shing 'dus pa'i rak+ta rang 'bab bcas yod/ gzhan yang tshogs drug rang grol gyis/shar na dpal rdor sgrub gnas yod/ /phyogs de'i ri brag 'ga' zhig la/ rigs gsum mgon po sgrol ma sogs/ /lha tshogs mang bo gnas so zhes/ /sngon byon mkhas grub du mas gsungs/ /zhes gsung ba ltar lags la/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje gnas 'dir bzhugs pa ni/ gnam rdzong rtse'i lam sgo bsrung nas bya ra mdzad pa 28

le'u gsum pa/ phyi dar bstan pa'i me ro bablangs tshul/dang / mkhas pa mi gsum gyi bzhugs gnas de ru gal srid nyen brda 'dra thos yong tshe/ de ma thag 'thab 'gog byed pa'i khur chen ma bsgos rang skal du bsnams yod/ mtshams 'dir lha lung dpal rdor gyi rnam thar cung zad zhu na/ khong ni dbu ru gung bo cher 'khrungs shing / skya bo'i dus su stag nya bzang zer/ nar son nas rgya bod so srung ba'i dmag mir song zhing / dmag rtsal sbyang ba'i mchog tu gyur cing g.yul 'khrug rnams las rgyal bar byung /mtshams shig la thugs nges 'byung gis bskul te/ dmag gral nas 'bud thabs byas te dbus su 'byor zhing / mched gnyis dang lhan du paṇa chen bi ma mi tra las rab tu byung / mtshan la dpal gyi rdo rjer gsol/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma sam bha wa las byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa blangs pa dang / gsang sngags kyi dbang dang gdams pa mang po thob/ rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i gras kyi nyer gsum pa yin/ gnyags chen lo tsā ba ye shes sde'i slob ma'i gtso bo yin/ phur ba mkhan po dpal gyi bu brgyad du grags pa las/ sog po dpal gyi ye shes/ 'o bran dpal gyi gzhon nu/gnyags chen dpal dbyangs thag bzang/ dpal gyi rdo rje ste dpal snga ba bzhi dang / lam mchog dpal gyi rdo rje/ dar rje dpal gyi grags pa/ gra dpal gyi snying bo/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje ste dpal gyi phyi ma bzhi bcas dpal gyi bu brgyad gras kyi phyi ma yin/29

ma chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/yang parnyi dzi na mi tra dang lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs gnyis kyi drung nas mngon pa gong 'og gi bsgyur bshad mdzad cing / rna nam zla ba'i rdo rje dang / lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje/ dbas rgyal ba ye shes gsum las gnang bar gsungs pa ltar/ nyi zla ltar grags pa'i bshes gnyen de dag gi drung du bsnyen nas mkhas grub chen por gyur/ (mdo smad chos 'byustelas/ mkhas pa mi gsum dang lha lung dpal rdor a chung gnam rdzong du yun ring bzhugs shing sgom khrid bskyangs zhes gsungs pa ltar/ khong nyid mkhas pa mi gsum dang lhan du a chung gnam rdzong du bgrang bya nyi shu lhag la bzhugs pa'i ring grub pa thob pa'i bu chen yang 'bol gyi rgyal ba byang chub sems dpa' dang / chu stod nyi ma'i 'khor lo/ ston pa 'o de sham po/ slob dpon 'phags pa li khrod/ gzhan yang khong gi slob brgyud du grags pa'i grub thob pa a lcags g.ya' ma me 'bud/ ka ba me tog char 'bebs/ rma skam nyi ma thag rtod/ 'khod sa thang thog 'phen/ lo khog thog 'dzin/ thang skam bla ma/ ra thod gdugar skya bo sngags 'chang / sum mdo bla ma sogs grub chen mang po byung ngo / sku tshe'i smad du ri bo tan tig dang khams ldan thang du byon nas bstan pa la bya ba mang po byas nas mthar 'od skur yal bar ngag rgyun la grags so/ /(thod phreng rtsal gyi lha 'dre'i thang yig nyumado smad a chung gnam rdzong brag phug tu/ ma sangs rgyal bo 30

le'u gsum pa/ phyi dar bstan pa'i me ro bslangs tshul/'gengs pa bzhugs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gnam rdzong rtse'i brag phug dang po ma sangs rgyas bo 'gengs ba gnas par grags pa'i phug pa der gtsang rab gsal bzhugs pa dang / de'i tshun nas g.yo dge 'byung dang dmar shākya bzhugs pa'i phug pa gnyis kyang rim bzhin byung / de'i 'og tu yod pa'i phug pa de ni khong rnam pa tsho'i ja khang yin par grags/ mkhas pa mi gsum sgrub phug dang lha lung dpal sdor sgrub phug bar phan tshun 'od zer dkar po zhig gi 'brel tshul yod pa las dag pa du mas mthong myong / de ni khong rnam pa bstan 'gro'i don la thugs dgongs gcig tu 'dres pa'i byin mthu dang rten 'brel gyi rang rtags yin zhes dam pa mang bos gsungs/ de ltar mkhas pa mi gsum gsang ba thub pa'i gnas 'dir yun ring sgom sgrub bskyangs shing / bla chen pos mkhas pa mi gsum las bslab pa bzhes pa'i tshul la/ (deb dmar lagaglang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pa'i tshe/ dpal chu bo ri nas/ gtsang rab gsal/ g.yo dge 'byung / dmar shākya mu ne gsum gyis 'dul ba dre'u khal gcig bkal nas mnga' ris su bros/ gar log nas hor yul bskor te mdo smad a chung gnam rdzong du slebs pa dang / bon po'i bu mu zu gsal 'bar dad nas/ gtsang gis mkhan po g.yos slob dpon byas te dge tshul byas/ mtshan dge ba gsal du btags/ phyis su dgongs pa rab gsal du grags/ lo 31

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/gcig na sngar gyi mkhan slob dang / dmar gyis gsang ston byas/lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes rgyal bo bsad nas kha skong mi rung gsungs nas/ rgya'i ha shang gnyis btang ste/ de lnga la bsnyen rdzogs byas/ de nas lo lnga nas mkhan po dgongs pa rab gsal la/grum ye shes rgyal mtshan/ snubs dpal gyi dbang phyug gis rab tu byung / de rnams kyi lo rgyus bsam yas nas mnga' bdag tsha lan ye shes rgyal mtshan yab sras kyis gsan nas/ dbus gtsang gi mi drug rim par brdzangs te/ dbus nas klu mes shes rab tshul khrims/ 'bring ye shes yon tan/ gtsang nas tshong btsun shes rab seng ge /lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug rnams kyis/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal las sdom pa blangs/ dba' btsun blo gros dbang phyug rag shi tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sum pa ye shes 'byung gnas rnams kyis grum snubs gnyis las sdom pa blangs te/ de rnams la sba rag gnyis gcig tu bgrangs pas mi drug zer ro/zhes dang / (lde'u chos 'byung lasadapal chu bo ri'i sgom grwa nas g.yo dge 'byung / rtsangs rab gsal/ dmar shākya mu ne gsum yod pa hor gyi yul tu phyin pas/ der yang chos lugs la dgongs par ma nus te/ hor gyi dge bsnyen shākya sra ba dang 'grogs te/mdo smad an chung gnam rdzong gi dgon par zhugs tshe/ bla chen des zhal ta byon pas 'brel nas chos gcig bslab par zhus pas/32

le'u gsum pa/ phyi dar bstan pa'i me ro bslangs tshul/'dul ba 'od ldan gnang ste 'di nas mar ltos dang dad na bya yis gsungs/ de khyer nas lam khar blta zhing phyin pas/ dad che nas mchi ma yang byung skad/ de nas zla ba gcig lon nas rab tu byung ste/ g.yos mkhan po byas/ rtsangs kyis slob dpon byas/dmar gyis gsang te ston pa byas nas rgya nag ha shang ka ba dang /ha shang gan 'bag dang / gnyis rab tu byung nas bla chen la mkhan slob gnyis kyi ming gras nas dge ba gsal du brtags(btags)me ro blangs pas bla chen/ skye bo'i ming ka ra 'phan/ bon po'i ming gsas 'bar ro/ de nas lo 'ga' na/ grum 'bar bya ba bas/ gsum po la rab tu 'byin par zhus pas/ g.yo dge 'byung na re/ kho bo cag ni rgas pas mkhan bu mi skyongs(skyong)dge ba gsal gyis mkhan po gyis la gnas gzhi tshugs/ bstan pa rgyas par spel zhes gsungs pas/ dge ba gsal na re/ bdag gis sdom pa blangs nas lo lnga las ma lon par de ltar rung ngam zhus pas/ nged mkhan slob la dri ma zhad tsam 'phog ste/ sdom pa skye ba la mi gnod pa gyis shig gsungs nas/ dge ba gsal gyis mkhan po byas/ rtsangs kyis slob dpon byas te grum 'bar ba rab tu byung nas ming yang ye shes rgyal mtshan du brtag(btagagade tsa na dbus na sdom pa blang sa med de/ bla chen spyan sngar dbus gtsang gi mi bdun gyis sdom pa len du phyin pa ni/ shab kyi sngon mo lung 33

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/nas tshong btsun shes rab seng ge rgyal 'go ri phug nas lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug sha tsha nas klu mes shes rab tshul khrims/ 'bring yas nas 'bring gza' ka ra/ ca btsun blo gros dbang phyug rag sha tshul khrims 'byung gnas/ sum pa ye shes blo gros rnams kyis bla chen las sdom pa blangs zhes sogs dang / yang(myang chos 'byustelas/ bla chen 'phan yul gzhong ba ru mu 'bar zhes bya ba'i bon po zhig gi bu mu su dge 'bar zhes su 'khrungs/ lo bcu gcig lon nas snang gsal lha khang du phyin nas/ rab byung chos 'chad pa nyan pa'i gzugs gyang ris la 'dug pa mthong nas/ 'di ci yin dris par/ rgas mo na re/ rab tu byung ba'i gzugs yin zer/las 'phro'i stobs kyis dad pa dang gus pa skyes te/ 'di 'dra ba gang na yod dris pas/ rgas mo de na re/ gzhan ni khungs ma mthong / chu bo ri nas bros pa'i dmar g.yo gtsang gsum ni nges par du 'dug zer ro/ de'i tshe las 'phro sad de/ chos min pa yid la mi dran pa'i dad pa skyes/ mdo smad du 'tshol du byon te/ lam du bon po gcig gi sar bsdad nas gtam dris par/ de kun a chung gnam rdzong brag phug na yod/ 'di yang chos su 'dug gi 'khyer ram zer nas 'dul ba 'od ldan gyi po ti gcig sbyin/ lam du lha'i byin pa'i dad pa shugs drag po rang 'khrungs su skyes/ a chung gnam rdzong du byon te dbus pa mi drug dang hwa shang gnyis te 34

le'u gsum pa/ phyi dar bstan pa'i me ro bslangs tshul/brgyad po 'tshogs nas/ lha lung dpal dbyangs rab 'byor gyis mkhan po byas/ rong ston seng ge grags kyis slob dpon dang /gtsang rab gsal gyis las byas/ gzhan rnams kyis dad pa'i dge 'dun mdzad de bsnyen par rdzogs par mdzad/ de nas thos pa mdzad tshul ni/ mkhan po la 'dul ba lung sde bzhi/ ka la rgyas pa'i bstan bcos sde lnga/ dmar g.yo gnyis la 'dul ba mdo man chod kyi phran tshegs/ rong ston la sdom rnam gnyis dang mdzod dbu ma/ gtsang la byā ka ra na sde brgyad sogs lo nyi shu rtsa stod cig la thos pa rgya cher mdzad nas bzhugs so/ /(khams ra'i lo rgyus tshigs bcad ma tasbu ra'i sgra dbyangasalas/ dmar g.yo gtsang gi ngur smrig 'dzin gsum dang / bdud rgyal gshed ma dpal gyi rdo rje rnams/ rim bzhin gnas 'dir byon nas gangs ljongs kyi/ /bstan pa'i chag che nyams nga yongs zhi tshe/ rigs bzang mu zi gsal 'bar thog drangs te/ /bstan pa'i me ro mdo khams smad nas gsos/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gangs can ljongs 'dir bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs dpal gyi bsam yas nas dar ba dang /phyi dar gyi skabs a chung gnam rdzong gi gnas 'di nas mu zi gsal 'bar ram bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal sogs la dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal zhing / gzhi dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i bstan pa rin po che gnas 'di nas nyams gso mdzad pas/35

ma chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/(khams ra'i lo rgyus tshiṭa bcad ma tamyu ra'i sgra dbyangagalas/gangs can ljongs 'dir bstan pa snga phyi ru/ /dar ba'i gnas gnyis dpal gyi bsam yas dang / /mdo smad a chung gnam rdzong gang dag las/ /gzhan du yod dam gzu bor gnas pa rnams/ /zhes gsungs/ de nas rim gyis rma klung rdo rje brag ra dang / ri bo tan tig sogs su phebs nas sgom sgrub yun ring bskyangs shing /chos 'chad nyan rgya cher mdzad pas/ mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul ltar mdo smad a chung gnam rdzong gzhir bcas yar dbus gtsang gi yul gru thams cad dge 'dun gyi sdes bkang nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad/ de'i phyir(mdo smad chos 'byugadu'ang / mkhas pa mi gsum dang bla chen po'i bka' drin las bstan pa'i me ro gang nas bslangs pa'i gzhir gyur pa'i 'phags yul dbus 'gyur 'chang gnyis par bsngags 'os pa zhes snga phyi'i mkhas pa du mas a chung gnam rdzong la bsngags pa ltar ro/ /mthar mkhas pa mi gsum da lta'i zi ling grong khyer gyi gnas der phebs nas sku mya ngan las 'das/ da lta gnas de ni zi ling grong khyer gyi lte ba mkhas pa mi gsum lha khang (ta klo gizer ba'i dgon pa der ngos 'dzin bzhin yod/ bla chen po yang mthar dmar gtsang brag tu phebs te sku mya ngan las 'das so/ /36

le'u gsum pa/ phyi dar bstan pa'i me ro bslangs tshul/smras pa/ sdig can mi dbang u dum btsan po'i log smon nag po'i bsam sbyor gyis/ /kha ba'i chos srid shul med btang bas mtha' 'khob mun pa'i dpung 'khrigs tshe/ /zla med thugs bskyed smon lam grub pa'i gangs can mkhas pa mi gsum gyis/ /slar yang rgyal bstan nyi ma gzhon nu mdo smad dbang phyogs mkha' ru drangs //37

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/le'u bzhi ba/ gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling gi byung ba brjod pa/gnam rdzong sngags mang dgon gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling ni/ bstan pa snga dar gyi skabs nyid nas 'du khang chung ba zhig yod par grags/ slob dpon chen pos kyang〈bka' thang sde lpilas/mdo smad an chung gnam rdzong na/ /ma sengs rgyal bo 'gengs pa bzhugs/ zhes gsungs pa la dpags na gnas 'dir lo ngo stong phrag lhag gi sngon nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang dgon sde chags myong bas slob dpon chen pos ma sangs 'gengs pa yul khams 'di'i spyi'i bstan pa srung bar gnyer gtad mdzad pa rjes dpags tshad mas shes thub/ glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs tshe spyi lo905yas mas su bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum dang lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje gnas 'dir byon te bgrang bya nyi shu rtsa stod cig la bzhugs nas mdo sngags chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor bas/ lha lung dpal rdor gyi chos rgyun 'dzin pa'i bu slob kyang mang du 'phel ba byung / khong gi slob rgyud du gtogs pa'i grub brnyes rig 'dzin yang mtsho kha'i rma rdor/ 'khod sa thang thog 'phen/ lo khog thog 'dzin/ dgu rong a lcags g.ya' ma me 'bud/ rma skam nyi ma thag 38

le'u bzhi ba/gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling gi byung ba brjod pa/ rtod/ ka ba me tog char 'bebs/ rang re'i gnubs khams ra gseg khas sde ba nas sku 'khrungs pa'i rdzas sngags ting 'dzin gyi nus ldan pa sngags 'chang ra thod gdug dang / ra skya bo/ sum mdo bla ma/ khams chung sde ba nas sku 'khrungs pa'i thang skam bla ma sogs kyis mtshon/ de'i dus gcan tsha'i yul nas phyogs bcu'i khro bo bcu zer ba'i sngags 'chang mthu chen mang po byung ba yang dpal gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i rnam sprul lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje khong gi chos rgyun zab mo'i rgyud pa 'dzin mkhan sha stag yin pas/ chu mgo gangs la thug pa ltar/ a chung gnam rdzong gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling gi sngags pa'i rgyud lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje nas byung bar mngon/ phyis su rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i nang du dpal o rgyan smin grol gling gi khri rabs gnyis pa gter sras pad+ma 'gyur med rgya mtsho'i dngos slob rlangs bla ma rig 'dzin dpal ldan bkra shis gnas 'dir zhabs kyi pad+mo nye bar bkod de/gnubs khams ra'i gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa rnams rjes su bzung ste/ rig 'dzin gdung sgrub dang tshes bcu tshugs par byas shing / chos thog gi skor mang bo btsugs nas 'don chos spyod dang / bca' ga phyag len rnams gzab khrid gnang / yang lo tshigs gsal kha ma nges mod rdzogs chen pad+ma rig 'dzin gyi dngos slob 'ga' gnas 'dir phebs nas yun ring sgom sgrub byas shing 39

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs/ dgon 'di'i rgyab ri'i ngos su rang byung brag phug yod pa'i nang du mkhas pa mi gsum gyi phyag bzo'i tsha tsha du ma dang / lha lung dpal rdor gyi na bza'/ yo byad kha shas/gzhan chos dpe sna kha mang po bzhugs pa phyis su sku mang bo par nas kha bkang zhing 'dag zhal byas te bzhugs pas na rgyab ri byin rten phyur bur gtams pa'i brag phug ces gleng / de'i rjes khams ra sngags mang gis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor lcang lung dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med gnas 'dir zhabs sor bkod de/gnam rdzong gi sngags 'chang rig pa 'dzin pa rnams gcig bsdus byas shing/ shar gyi phyogs na ma mo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i shing sdong rkang gcig dang / lho ru gnod sbyin brag dmar gru gsum/ nub tu mkha' gro'i rak+ta rang 'bab/ byang du mkhas pa'i gsang lam/dbus su mkha' 'gro'i bro ra rang byon du yod pa'i gnas kyi snying bor bod rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i dngos po zhes pa shing pho khyi'i spyi lo1814lor gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling gi sde 'di nyid phyag 'debs gnang ste thugs brtse ba chen pos bskyangs/phyis su lcang lung dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med mchog gi thugs kyi sprul ba sna tshogs rang grol tshang byon nas dgon 'dir zhabs kyis bcags nas rjes su bzung / khong gis gnam rdzong rtse nas lo gcig ring la rta mgrin yang gsang gi bsnyen sgrub gnang 40

le'u bzhi ba/ gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling gi byung ba brjod pa/zhing / de'i dus sgrub khang bzhengs skabs sa 'og nas gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu ba rnyed pas/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa dar ba'i rten 'brel 'grig gsungs/ rje 'di'i ring la sngags mang gi 'du khang rgya bskyed nas bzhengs dgos stabs/sngags mang byings nas 'du khang bzhengs sa sgrol ma'i lha khang gi shul bzang snyam yod kyang / sna tshogs rang grol rin po ches nas do kya'i bsil kha'i sngags 'chang la sa 'dul gyi bka' gnang /sngags 'chang gis da lta'i 'du khang phug sa de ji 'dra red legs sam zhus pas/ khong rin po ches sa brkos dang shes 'ongs gsung ba ltar brkos par ra dung kha shas dang tsen gnyis sa 'og nas byung bas der 'du khang bzhengs/ 'du khang gi ka ring thag pas 'then nas yar slong skabs drang bo ma song bar thag pa chad nas nyen khar gyur tshe/ glo bur du rlung 'tshub cig 'khor nas ka ring dkris pa'i tshul byas te ka ba drang bo dang brtan par gyur ba na rlung 'tshub yal ba kun gyis mthong bas dad pa dang ngo mtshar skyes/sna tshogs rang grol rin po ches dgon 'dir rten bzhengs mang po byas pa dang / kun spyod sgrig lam dang / chos thog thoso btsugs te 'bud rdung dkrol gsum/ 'don rta dbyangs tshun chad gtan la phab ste 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang bas/ rma chu'i byang rgyud kyi gsang sngags rnying ma ba'i dgon sde thams cad kyi mig dpe lta bur 41

spoyo gnam rdzong gi lo khyus/gyur/ bod rab byung bco lnga'i rnam 'phyang zhes pa sa pho khyi'i1898lor/ sna tshogs rang grol gyi sku phreng phyi ma dgu sprul o rgyan 'jigs bral chos dbyings rdo rje mchog gis 'du khang rgya bskyed nas bzo bkod dang bzo rtsal khyad du 'phags pa/ 'du khang gi steng du g.yu thog gis mdzes pa dang / gser gyi gardzo ra dang rgyan mtshan/ chos 'khor/ spen rgyan bcas kyis spras nas zur bzhi logs brgyad kyi rnam par grub pa'i 'du khang brjid nyams ldan pa zhig legs par bzhengs grub byung / 'du khang gi nang rten la gser zangs las grub pa'i slob dpon rin po che dang / dpal ldan a ti sha/ rje bdag nyid chen mo/ rta mgrin yang gsang li sku mi tshad longs pa gcig li sku khros pa lha dgu gu ru mtshan brgyad li ma che ba dang / gu ru rin po che'i gyan thang / gu ru'i rnam thar/ 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod/ mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod/sgrol ma'i zhing bkod/ bshags lha so lnga/ thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol/ bka' brgyad/ gu drag phur ba/ rta mgrin/ rma rgyal bcas kyi gyan thang mang bo bzhugs/ gsung gi rten la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur gtsos gsung 'bum glegs bam mang bo bzhugs/ thugs kyi rten la spyi khru gang re longs pa'i dngul dkar gyi mchod rten cha brgyad bzhugs/ khyad par du byin rlabs kyi tshan kha ma nyams pa'i gna' bo'i rten rnying bzhugs pa ni/42

le'u bzhi ba/ gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling gi byung ba brjod pa/sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi 'phel gdung / shākya thub pa'i 'phel gdung che ba/ slob dpon rin po che'i dbu spa/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi phyag phreng / pha dam pa'i sgom thag mi la ras pa'i sgom thag sogs rten sna rtsa chen mang bo bzhugs/ da dung dgu rong rin po ches rgya nag nas gdan drangs pa'i gser zangs kyi li sku che chung mang po dang / rin thang che ba'i mchod cha dang / mchod rdzas kyi rigs mang po 'du khang nang du sbyor 'jags gnang /tshogs zangs bkra shis 'khyil ba yang 'di'i skabs su blugs/sngon gyi 'du khang rnying bar sangs rgyas stong sku/ bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan mang po dang chos dpe po ti mang po bzhugs/ mgon khang du ko'u ba chos rgya mtsho tshang mgon po rdzong na bzhugs dus gnang ba'i mgon po'i sku brnyan/ mgon po tshogs kyi bdag po/ dam can/sngags srung ma/ hor mo/ gza'/ rma rgyal bcas bzhugs/ 'du khang gi g.yon na zhi khro'i lha khang gyan lnga yod/ nang du slob dpon yab yum gyi sku brnyan dang / zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs/rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ bla ma sum cu so drug gi snang brnyan sogs bzhugs/ 'du khang gi g.yas su par khang bkra shis chos mdzod gyan lnga bzhugs/ dgu rong 'jigs bral chos dbyings rdo rje mchog khams la phebs nas sde dge rgyal bo'i dbu blar bzhugs skabs/ sde dge rgyal bo nas khong nyid kyi thugs bzhed ltar dpar 43

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/brko mgon tshe dang / a 'brug tshe brtan sogs mngags nas/klong chen mdzod bdun/ mkhas 'jug spyod 'jug chen mo/bka' thang shel brag ma/ kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung / thar mdo khri lag len ma/ dran pa nyer bzhag rgyud gsang ba snying bo/ nyag phrug byang chub sems dpa'i rnam thar chos bshad gzhan phan nyi zla/rtsa gsum/ le'u bdun ma/ 'das log rnam thar/ 'khor ba dbyings sgrol/ bdud 'dul drag mo/ gu ru drag dmar/ ye shes bla ma/ zhi khro/ smyung gnas cho ga bzang spyod/ mdo gdugs sgrol gsum sogs 'don cha mang po dang / pad+ma dri med dkar bo/dkar rtsis dge legs nyi ma/ dag yig ngag sgron/ nag rtsis sngon 'gro/ sum rtags/ chos dbyings rang grol gyi rnam thar sogs par shing mang po bzhugs/ de'i dus dgu rong rin po ches sde dge rgyal bo'i pho brang nas sgrol ma'i li sku gsung 'byon ma zhig spyan drangs 'ongs pa nang rten gyi snying bor byas nas sgrol ma'i lha khang bzhengs shing / gzhan sgrol ma nyer gcig bshags lha so lnga li ma khri gang ba tsam re dang / li las grub pa'i thub dbang gi sku mi tshad/ rje btsun byams pa sogs sku brnyan mang bo bzhugs/ dgu rong rin po ches brag dkar them chen thang gzhung nas bton pa'i skar rdo rin po che'ang bshams ston du bkod yod/ gnam rdzong rtse yar nang na rta mgrin yang gsang gi lha khang dang / zangs mdog dpal 44

le'u bzhi ba/ gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling gi byung ba brjod pa/ri'i sgrub phug yod/ nang rten gtso sku la slob dpon rin po che dang g.yas g.yon du rnga yab gling gi srin po'i grong khyer gyi bkod pa 'jigs yer ba bzhengs yod/ 'jigs bral chos dbyings rdo rje khong gi ring la gnam rdzong rtse yar nang nas gzim khang gsar phug byas te sngon mo rdzong nas khong gis gter nas bton pa'i gser sku zhig yod pa gzim khang gi nang rten la bzhugs par grags/ dgon 'dir rgyun bzhugs mdzad pa'i bla ma rnams kyi sgar khag so so ni/ sku phyogs dgu rong sgar ba/ chos dbyings sgar ba/ zir tshang sgar ba/ mkha' 'da' sgar ba/ sgur steng sgar ba/kun bzang sgar ba/ blon chos sgar ba/ sgo me sgar ba/ rdo ring kha sgar ba/ zhabs drung sgar ba/ a lags nyi ma'i sgar ba bcas yin/sgrub sde 'di'i lo gcig ring gi chos thog gi rim pa ni/ hor zla dang po'i tshes drug nas bco lnga bar thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol rdul tshon dang bcas pa tshugs nas nyin mtshan gnyis la ma ṇi gsung ba'i sgra mi 'chad par sgrub dgos/ tshes bco lnga'i gar 'cham la/ ging chen bcu drug dang / khro bo bcu'i 'cham/zhwa nag pa bcu/ ma gza' rdor gsum/ bdud btsan klu gsum/ khro bo khro mo/ shwa 'cham gnyis/ gdong mo bzhi/ ging can sde bzhi/sgrol ging gnyis bcas yod/ zla gsum pa'i nang nyin bdun gyi ring seng gdong dang / gu drag snang brgyad bcas gsungs/ zla 45

ma chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/bzhi ba'i nang do kya/ khams ra/ ske ba bcas kyi sngags sde gsum lo rer res mos tshul gyis nyin bdun la sirnyi sgrub chen yin/ zla lnga ba'i nang 'od dpag med kyi stong mchod nyin gsum la 'tshogs dgos/ zla drug pa'i nang bka' brgyad khyung dgu ma nyin bdun la 'tshogs dgos/ zla brgyad pa'i nang nyin lnga'i ring zhi khro'i chos thog zla dgu ba'i nang tshes nyer bdun nas nyer dgu bar ban sngags gnyis kyis sngags 'du 'tshogs dgos la/ sngags pa rnams kyis bka' brgyad dang gu drag skor gnyis byas nas 'tshogs/bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi dge 'dun pa tshos mgon chos gsungs/zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga bar bskang 'don skor zhig dang / gtor sgrub skor/ gar 'cham gshar sbyang gi skor bcas sngags pa rnams skor khag bgos nas 'tshogs dgos/ zla re'i yar ngo mar ngo la tshes bcu 'tshogs pa sogs rgyun ldan gyi phyag srol mang po yod/ dgon 'dir dgu rong sku phreng lnga phyi gtsos rdzogs chen sku phreng rim byon dang / skyabs mgon tshogs drug rang grol sku phreng snga phyi/ rdo brag rig 'dzin chen mo/ rig 'dzin dpal ldan bkra shis/ rdzogs chen pad+ma rig 'dzin gyi zhal slob 'ga'/rdzogs chen sku phreng bzhi ba thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje/ gter ston bsod rgyal rin po che sogs snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms kyi bla chen rnams snga phyir phebs nas/ rdzogs chen 46

le'u bzhi ba/gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling gi byung ba brjod pa/a ti yo ga'i chos skor gtso byas gsang sngags rgyud sde yongs kyi dbang lung khrid gsum dang / mdo phyogs bka' pod lnga'i 'chad nyan rgya cher mdzad pa'i thugs rjes las/ mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtshor gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i khams ra'i mkhan po rnam gsum gtso byas dpyod ldan gyi sngags 'chang gang mang zhig byung / rnam 'phyang zhes pa sa pho khyi'i spyi lo1958lor rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la nag phyogs 'byung bo'i tshogs kyis nye zho ya nga ba btang bas/ dgon 'di'i rin thang gzhal du med pa'i sku gsung thugs rten rnams gtor brlag byas shing / khang ba gyan lnga'i nang phyur bur gtams pa'i dpar shing yod do cog khams ra zhang gi ja khang du 'bud shing byas nas dgon 'di'i rten dang brten pa shul med du btang / de nas rim gyis chos lugs slar gso'i nyi gzhon gyi gom stabs lha mi 'gro ba yongs kyi bsod nams dang bde skyid kyi dpal du chas pa'i skabs/ bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i thun mong zhes pa lcags pho khyi'i spyi lo1970lor sngags 'chang ban kho dang / ma ṇi/ rdo rje 'bum/ rgya gzhi/ nor phyug sogs kyis mtshon khams ra sngags mang yongs kyis gnam rdzong rtse'i yar nang na sngags khang dang / zangs mdog dpal ri'i sgrub phug gnyis gsar bzhengs byas nas lo de'i zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig la chos sgo phyes/ bag med ces pa chu mo glang gi spyi 47

bhāchung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/lo1973lor sngags mang gis sngon gyi ja khang gi shul du 'du khang chung ba zhig bzhengs/ zad pa ces pa'i me pho stag gi spyi lo1986lor/ dgu rong rgyal sras dang sprul sku grol lo rnam gnyis kyis bdag rkyen bstsal ba gzhir byas khams ra mang tshogs yongs kyis zhabs 'degs la brten nas/ sngon gyi 'du khang gi shul ma nor ba byas nas 'du khang chen mo gsar bzhengs kyi 'go brtsams te ka ring yar bslangs nas gzhu ring thung la sprod dus 'phal ga ma 'phrod par gyur tshe/ de ma thag sa g.yos pa byung ba'i 'gul shugs kyis ka ring dang ka thung sogs legs 'phrod byung bas der gnas kun gyis rten 'brel bzang bor go zhing dad pa'i nges shes 'drongs/ lo gsum gyi ring dpal 'byor gyi 'gro gron mang bo btang zhing sngags mang byings nas 'bad brtson lhod med byas mthar/ mnyam med thub pa'i dbang bos chos kyi 'khor lo thengs gsum la bskor bar mtshon byed rtseg ma gsum las grub pa'i 'du khang chen mo'i phyi'i bkod pa yongs su legs 'grub byung /nang rten bzhengs kyi rim pa ni/ gtso sku la sman 'dam las grub pa'i o rgyan snang srid zil gnon dang g.yas su 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang rgyal pa'i bka' 'gyur chen mo/ g.yon du sgrol ljang dang bstan 'gyur chen mo bcas bzhugs/ g.yas kyi logs ngos su 'od dpag med kyi zhing bkod/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'gro 48

le'u bzhi ba/ gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling gi byung ba brjod pa/'dul phyag bzhi ba/ phur ba bdud dpung zil gnon/ bka' brgyad/ glo sgo'i steng ngos su khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba bcas kyi gyan thang bzhugs/ g.yon gyi logs ngos su rdo rje sems dpa'/thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol/ zhi khro/ gu drag rta mgrin gsang sgrub bcas kyi gyan thang bzhugs/ sum thog gi gnam rgyan steng rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i logs bris dang / nyis thog gi rgya mthongs nang du dgu rong 'jigs bral chos dbyings rdo rje'i sku gdung mchod rten gtsos mchod rten cha brgyad bzhugs pa dang /sman 'dam las grub pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad bcas bzhugs/gzhan gtsag drub kyi rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs zhal thang grangs mang dang / sgo khyams kyi logs ngos gnyis su sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa 'bur du thon zhing sa/son nyams ldan pa'i rgyal chen sde bzhi bcas bzhugs su gsol lo/ /btsan khang chen mor yul 'di'i bstan srung ma sangs 'gengs pa gtso byas/ sngags srung ma/ gza'/dam can sogs snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i chos skyong mang bo'i snang brnyan bzhugs/ da lta dgon 'dir sngon gyi chos thog skor zhig bskyar du btsugs yod pa'i rim pa ni/ lo re'i cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes drug nas bco lnga'i bar thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa bzhengs nas nyin mtshan gnyis la ma ṇi gsung ba'i sgra mi 'chad par sgrub dgos shing / bco lnga'i 49

ma chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/nyin gyi gar 'cham la khro bo bcu/ ma gza' rdor gsum/ bdud btsan klu gsum/ khro bo khro mo/ sha 'cham/ gdong mo bzhi/ ging can sde bzhi/ sgrol ging gnyis bcas yod/ hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bzhi nas bcu drug par gu drag 'don/ hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes drug nas bcu gsum bar rig 'dzin sgrub chen yin/ zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu bzhi nas bcu drug par 'od dpag med kyi stong mchod yin/ zla brgyad pa'i tshes bzhi nas drug par zhi khro 'don/zla bcu ba'i tshes drug nas bcu gcig bar bka' brgyad sogs chos thog mang po btsugs yod pas/ lo rer sngags pa gnyis res dad ldan yongs la zhal 'debs bslangs nas gong gi chos thog yongs kyi mthun rkyen sbyor dgos/ de ltar dgon 'di'i chos thog so so dang / 'don rta dbyangs/ 'bud rdung dkrol gsum/ bca' ga phyag len sogs dgon 'dir bka' drin shin tu che ba'i bla ma —rin po che 'jam dbyangs chos 'phel lam yongs grags su sprul sku grol lo mchog gis sngags pa rnams la zhib khrid gnang zhing / dus dang rnam pa kun tu lugs gnyis kyis gzigs skyong bla med gnang bas/ snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i sgrub sde bzang bo zhig tu gyur stabs khams ra'i sngags mang zhes mtshan snyan gyi grags pa dkar bo bod yul gyi sa phyogs kun la khyab/ bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i rab myos zhes pa lcags pho rta yi spyi lo1990lor sprul sku grol lo rin 50

le'u bzhi ba/gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling gi byung ba brjod pa/po ches thugs bkod dang phyag rdzas mang du bstsal nas/ khams ra sngags mang yongs dang btsun ma grwa tshang / rdzo mtshams pa grwa tshang bcas kyis sgrol ma'i lha khang gsar bzhengs kyi dbu brtsams te dka' spyad brtson 'grus kyi rgyun bskyangs pas/ me glang lor sgrol ma'i lha khang bshad sgrub nor bu'i dga' tshal gling gi phyi nang gi rten dang brten pa yongs su legs grub byung / gtsug lag khang 'di'i phyi'i bzo bkod ba gam rtseg ma gsum gyis brgyan cing /nang rten bzhengs kyi rim pa ni/ rtse thog gi dbus na gu ru bde ba chen po gtsos bsam lhun ltar gyi bkod par bzhengs/ g.yas su kun mkhyen yab sras kyi 'khrungs rabs/ g.yon du skyabs mgon zhabs dkar ba'i 'khrungs rabs/ bar thog gi kun dga' ra bar o rgyan snang srid zil gnon dang / g.yas su dgu rong sna tshogs rang grol gyi sku gdung mchod rten/ g.yon du sprul sku grol lo rin po che'i rtsa ba'i bla ma mkhan chen dbang rnyis tshang dang /dbang lo tshang / rig lo tshang bcas kyi sku gdung mchod rten/g.yas su rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che tshar gnyis/ g.yon du bstan 'gyur dang / rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum/ kun mkhyen yab sras kyi gsung 'bum/ bla ma mi pham rin po che'i gsung 'bum bcas bzhugs/ bar shod gnam rgyan gyi ngos su snying thig gong 'og gi bla brgyud cha tshang dang / bshags lha so lnga'i sku brnyan bris thang / 'og 51

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/shod du rnam 'dren thub pa'i dbang bo dang 'khor du gnas brtan bcu drug gi zhal thang chen mo/ g.yas phyogs su sman 'dam las grub pa'i slob dpon yab yum gsum dang gu ru mtshan brgyad/de'i g.yas phyogs su sman 'dam las grub pa'i rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang mtha' skor du rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku brnyan lnga brgya/g.yon phyogs su sman 'dam las grub pa'i rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang mtha' skor du rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku brnyan lnga brgya/g.yon phyogs su sman 'dam las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs dbang 'gro 'dul phyag bzhi ba dang / 'jam dbyangs/ gsang bdag ste rigs gsum mgon po/ mtha' skor du nye ba'i sras chen brgyad/ de'i g.yon phyogs su sman 'dam las grub pa'i rgyal yum chos kyi dpal mo dang / mtha' skor du rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku brnyan lnga brgya/ logs g.yas su klong snying skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing / de'i g.yas su zangs mdog dpal ri'i zhing bkod kyi gyan thang / logs g.yon du nub phyogs bde ldan zhing gi bkod pa dang / de'i g.yon du snying thig ltar gyi bka' brgyad phyag rgya rgyas pa'i gyan thang / glo sgo'i steng ngos su khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang /rdor sems/ rnam sras bcas kyi zhal thang / nang phyogs sgo chen gyi steng ngos su gza' gdong mo bzhi dang / de'i g.yas phyogs su bka' srung ma mgon sde lnga/ g.yon phyogs su smin gling lugs kyi 52

le'u bzhi ba/gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling gi byung ba brjod pa/rgyud mgon legs ldan la sogs pa'i zhal thang gtsos sku gsung thugs rten mang bo phyur bur gtams nas skye rgu 'gro ba yongs kyi tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i zhing dam par gyur/ yang na tshod ldan zhes pa shing mo phag gi spyi lo1995lor sprul sku grol lo rin po ches thugs bkod dang phyag rdzas mang du bstsal nas khams ra sngags mang gtsos btsun ma grwa tshang dang / phyogs yongs dad ldan rnams kyi tshegs brtson 'grus la brten nas/ gnam rdzong rtse yar nang du spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang mthong grol bkra shis gzi 'bar gsar bzhengs kyi dbu brtsams te me glang lor lha khang gi rten dang brten pa yongs su legs par grub/ nang brten bzhengs kyi rim pa ni/ sman 'dam las grub pa'i 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong bongs tshad la khri tshad nyi shu longs pa'i gtso sku chen mo dang / 'khor du 'jam dbyangs dang gsang bdag bar thog gi logs g.yas su 'od dpag med kyis gtsos spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs grangs mang / logs g.yon du gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis gtsos spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs grangs mang / 'og shod kyi gyan gsum na ston pa thub pa'i dbang bor 'khor gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba'i logs bris/ logs g.yas su thugs rje chen po don yon zhags pa dang /mtha' skor du spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs grangs mang / de'i 53

spochung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/g.yas su thugs rje po 'gro 'dul phyag bzhi ba dang mtha' skor du spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs grangs mang / log g.yon du thugs rje chen po seṅge sgra dang mtha' bskor du spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs grangs mang / de'i g.yon du thugs rje chen po mig 'byed dang mtha' bskor du spyan ras gzigs kyi lha tshogs grangs mang ste khyon bsdoms phyag na pad+mo'i sku brnyan stong rtsa gcig gi gyan thang rnams dang / sgo khyams kyi logs g.yas g.yon gnyis su rgyal chen sde bzhi'i gyan thang sogs bzhugs su gsol te lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi legs tshogs bsags pa'i mchod sdong chen mor grub/ nyi sgrol byed ces ba shing pho sprel gyi spyi lo2004lor bla ma rin po che sprul sku grol lo mchog gis thugs kyi bskyed pa rlabs po che mdzad de/ slob dpon rin po che'i 'das 'khrungs zung gi dus tshes khyad par can la khong nyid gtsor mdzad pa'i rdo grub sprul sku klong yangs tshang dang / 'ja' lus pa mkhan chen tshe dbang rig 'dzin rin po che'i sprul sku bstan 'dzin snyan grags tshang / rdzogs chen chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rje'i yang sprul 'jigs med chos dbyings rang grol rdo rje tshang sogs bla sprul bzhi bcu lhag dang / mdo dbus khams gsum nas phebs pa'i snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bzhi stong lhag gis khams ra'i sngags mang gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling gi sde 'di 54

le'u bzhi ba/ gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling gi byung ba brjod pa/nas nyin bdun gyi ring la dbang chen sprel zla'i rig 'dzin 'bum tshogs chen mo'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bskor/ yang mi zad ces pa me pho khyi'i spyi lo2006lor bla ma rin po che nas lugs gnyis kyi thugs khur zab bzhes gnang ste/ gangs ljongs smra ba'i dbang phyug mkhan chen dam pa tshul khrims blo gros rin po che gtsos grub mtha' ris med kyi bla sprul rnams dang / phyogs yongs nas phebs pa'i ngur smrig rgyal mtshan gsol ba'i rab byung gi sde dang / gos dkar lcang lo 'chang ba'i rig 'dzin sngags 'chang sogs mi grangs lnga stong lhag gis bzang bo spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal bo grangs tshad 'bum phrag lhag gis mtshams sbyar te gangs ljongs smon lam chen mo thengs gsum pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba dang / chos mtshams rnams su mkhan dam pa tshul khrims blo gros mchog gis dad ldan khyim pa pho mo yongs la skyabs 'gro dang dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bstsal zhing / bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyu bzhi'i ljags khrid zhib rgyas shig bstsal bas thams cad chos kyis tshims par byas/ thams cad 'dul zhes pa me mo phag gi spyi lo2007lo'i hor zla drug pa'i nang mchog sprul grol lo rin po che nas dmangs sgor chig 'bum brgyad khri lhag gi 'gro gron btang nas/ gnam rdzong rtse yar nang du spyan ras gzigs kyi lha khang mthong grol bkra shis gzi 'bar chen mo'i gtsug lag khang gi steng 55

ma chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/yongs su gser lcags spel ma'i shan gyis spras pas/ sngar las lhag pa'i gzi 'od gsar ba zhig gi rang mdangs 'bar bar byas so/ /de ltar dgon 'dir sngon nas da lta'i bar snga 'gyur rnying ma'i phyogs gyi mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi bla ma dam pa rnams snga phyir byon nas zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa dang /khyad par du gnam rdzong bla brang khag gi bla ma rnams kyi sku'i zhal skyin du bkur 'os pa'i rdo ring kha ba'i yang sprul bla ma rin po che 'jam dbyangs chos 'phel dpal bzang bo'am mtshan gzhan sprul sku grol lo mchog gis thog mtha' bar gsum du tshad med thugs rje'i snying bor bzung bas/ dgon 'di'i rnam dkar legs tshogs kyi bgyi ba thams cad dar zhing rgyas pa'i skabs nyid do/ /smras pa/ mtsho skyes rgyal ba'i gsang gsum sgyu 'phrul dgyu 'dus pad+mo ro5 gi sar/ /rig 'dzin bla ma'i gar du byon pa'i skyu 'ing snga sgyi'i 'dab stong gis/ /gagung sngagus rtsi bcud gter sdu bsgruzus pas snga 'gyur rgyal bstan rgyas so zhes/ /skal ldan rkang drug gzhon nu'i tshogs kyis lho gli5 khyon na 'ud kyis sgrog /56

le'u lnga ba/ bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/le'u lnga ba/ bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/gnam rdzong bkra shis rnam par rgyal ba'i gling 'di nyid thog ma'i byung tshul ni/ sngon ru tra'i log smon gyi dug mtsho snying na khol ba'i mi dbang u dum btsan pos mnyam med bu ram shing ba'i bstan pa rin po che yongs su bsnubs tshe/ dpal chu bo ri'i sgom grwa nas bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum ste/ dmar shākya mu ne dang /g.yo dge ba'i 'byung gnas/ gtsang dgongs pa rab gsal/ yer ba'i lha ri snying bo nas lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje rnams spyi lo905yas mas tsam la a chung gnam rdzong du phebs nas bgrang bya nyi shu rtsa stod cig gi ring la chos 'chad nyan dang sgom sgrub mdzad nas bzhugs pas/ dmar g.yo gtsang gsum gyi klog pa thos bsam dang spong pa bsam gtan gyi 'khor lo'i chos rgyun 'dzin pa'i bu slob ri khrod pa mang bo lu gu rgyud du byon nas/ sgrub pa snying bor mdzad nas bzhugs pa da lta'ang gnam rdzong rtse dang gnam rdzong stangs pa'i ri ngos so sor sgrub khang brtsigs pa'i shul mthong rgyu yod/ de dag gi thos bsam sgom gsum gyi chos rgyun gtsang ma'i bar ma chod par bya btang ri khrod pa mang bos gnas 57

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/'di nas bshad sgrub kyi rgyud chu bo'i rgyun ltar bsrings nas lo ngo brgya phrag du ma 'das/ phyis su dbus gtsang gi skyid shod sde ba chos rje bstan 'dzin blo bzang rgya mtsho tshang mdo smad du gnas 'brel 'jog par phebs nas brag bya khyung du bzhugs skabs/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i dngos po zhes pa shing pho khyi yi spyi lo1634lor ched du a chung gnam rdzong la gnas mjal du phebs te rten rnams la zhib tu mjal zhing gnas 'brel bzhagaganubs khams ra ba sogs kyi skya ser yongs la khrom chos gnang /bkra shis thang nas chos rje 'di ba tshang gis thugs rje chen po'i dbang gnang zer ba grags shing / khong gi bzhugs khri dus phyis bar du yod par gleng / yang bkra shis thang gi sde ba chos rje'i bzhugs khri'i nye 'khor du mdzod dge'i em mchi rin po che dang khong gi zhal slob ri khrod pa 'ga' bzhugs stabs/ rka phug parnyi ta sku phreng gnyis pa ste rka phug sgom chung ba sku na phra mo'i dus nas gnas 'dir phebs te/ mdzod dge'i em mchi tshang khong gi yongs 'dzin du bsten nas gsan sbyong rgya cher gnang zhing bka' chos nyan pa dang sgrub pa snying bor mdzad nas bzhugs/ de'i sku skyes 'jam dbyangs dbang phyug kyang gnas 'dir phebs pa sogs lo rgyus na gsal/ yul 'di'i ngag rgyun du/ bkra shis thang gi ri khrod pa rnams khams ra'i rdzong chen bco brgyad sogs su rtag tu 58

le'u lnga ba/bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/sgom sgrub la gzhol ba dang / chos thog 'tshogs pa'i skabs su rang rang gi sgrub phug las 'phur 'ongs te bkra shis thang du zhal 'dzoms zer/ de'i dus gnam rdzong rtse'i ri khrod pa rnams dang khams ra gle lnga'i dad ldan rnams kyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/rab byung bcu gsum pa'i kun dga' zhes pa shing pho stag gi spyi lo1794lor rka phug pasnyi ta sku phreng bzhi ba blo bzang don grub mchog gis sngon sde ba chos rje'i bzhugs khri'i steng lha khang chung ba zhig bzhengs te 'du khang gi tshab byas te/ gnam rdzong rtse'i ri khrod pa rnams bkra shis thang gi ri khrod pa rnams dang gcig bsdus byas te bkra shis rnam par rgyal ba'i gling 'di nyid phyag 'debs mdzad pa nas bzung gzhi gdam bya'i nyams len sogs tshugs par byas shing / dbang lung khrid gsum dang bka' chos mang du gsungs nas mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i dgon pa 'di 'dzin skyong zla med gnang / de'i dus gnubs khams ra ba rnams kyis zhus nas bya khyung rgyud pa grwa tshang phebs skabs/ dgon 'di nas rgyud grwa ba rnams bzhugs pa dang / rka phug rin po ches lung bka' chos mang du gnang ba khong gi rnam thar dang / 〈mdo smad chos 'byusteganyis kar gsal/ gnam rdzong rtse'i rka phug gzim khang yang parnyi ta khong gi sku ring la bzhengs pa yin/ de'i rjes su rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i dkar bo zhes pa sa mo sbrul gyi spyi lo1809lor chos rje gser 59
