bhāchung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/khang ba rin po che gnam rdzong rtser byon nas bzhugs skabs/ rka phug rin po che khong gi sku mdun du bcar nas dgon pa'i grwa ba rnams la chos 'brel stsol bar zhus pas/ lam rim chen mo dang /sngags rim chen mo/ myur lam gyi zab khrid/ phyag rgya chen po'i khrid sogs lung bka' chos mang du gnang zhing / ting phor brgya phrag lhag dang mchod thebs kyang mang du bstsal nas mchod pa 'bul ba'i rgyun btsugs pa da lta'ang lo re'i hor zla gsum pa'i nang nyin lnga'i ring la bla ma mchod pa dang sman bla'i phyag mchod gsungs nas mchod pa 'bum phrag lhag 'bul ba'i phyag srol ma nyams par yod/de'i dus gser khang rin po che phebs dus chibs mdzo dkar bo nyal sar rten 'brel du gzigs nas khong gis dgon 'dir mdun nub byang du gtad cing / dbyibs rgya phug lta bu'i 'du khang zhig bzhengs te/ nang rten la sangs rgyas stong sku/ gnas brtan bcu drug dkar po sku skyes kyis gnang ba'i sgrol ma gsung 'byon ma bcas bzhugs/ btsan khang du rdo rje 'jigs byed dang mgon chos lnga'i sku brnyan/ gnyan cha che ba'i dpal ldan lha mo/ rje gser khang bas gnang zhing bsten pa'i ma sangs rgyal bo'i zhal thang sku mdog dmar bo spyan gsum khro tshul can/ khrab mog ru dar 'khor gsum chas kyis brgyan zhing / phyag g.yas mdung dar dang g.yon pas zhags pa bsnams pa/ 'khor du klu bdud btsan gsum gyis 60

le'u lnga ba/ bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/bskor ba blta bas mi ngoms pa bcas bzhugs/ khyu mchog ces pa lcags mo sbrul gyi spyi lo1821lor rka phug rin po ches sngon khong gis bzhengs pa'i 'du khang chung ba de zhig gsos dang rab gnas mdzad de/ ka ring gi nang rten la rje gser khang ba'i zhabs lham/rje gser khang ba khong gi 'dra sku'i gzungs gzhug tu khong rang gi rnam sbyar bzhugs par gsungs/ rim gyis dgon pa 'di dar zhing rgyas pa dang chabs cig a mdzes la kha'i shar na khri ka'i bis kyā chung bas btab yod pa'i nags par dgon bya ba bstan srung mgon po phyag drug pa yin la/ mgon g.yag zhig tshe thar du phul ba de dgon pa'i dka' ngal sel phyir btsong ste chos thog gi thebs rtsar btang bas mgon po phyag drug pa thugs ma rangs pa'i tshul gyis dgon par chag 'jig byung stabs/ gnas spor byas yong ste bkra shis rnam rgyal gling 'di dang bsres shing / rka phug bla brang du lo rer mgon po gtor sgrub 'dzugs pa'ang mgon po'i thugs dam bskang ba'i ched yin zer/ yang rma chu byang rgyud du gnas pa'i ban kro brag nang na rdzong tog dgon zer ba zhig yod pa de yang gnas spor byas yong nas gnam rdzong rtser 'gro sa'i brag nor bu'i gsham du dgon rnying zer ba zhig yod pa de dang bsres/ phyis su de yang bkra shis rnam rgyal gling dang gcig tu bsres pas sku gsung thugs rten dang mtshod rdzos sogs shin tu mang zhing phyag len chos 61

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/spyod sgrig lam sogs gtsang ba'i dgon sde legs po zhig tu gyur/dgon 'di'i 'du khang gi nang rten la thub dbang gsung 'byon ma'i gtsos sangs rgyas stong sku dang / thub pa rdor gdan ma dang rje tshe 'dzin ma gnyis byin rten skad grags che/ de las gzhan byams sku li ma che chung gnyis dang / dngul dkar las grub pa'i khru gang can gyi gnas brtan bcu drug zhabs drung dkar bo'i sku sngon ma zhig gis gnang ba'i tshe dpag med li sku/ rje rin po che'i sku brnyan mi tshad gcig rje gser khang ba'i sku brnyan mi tshad gcig gser zangs las grub pa'i mgon chos lnga'i sku brnyan dang / skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing / bla mchod tshogs zhing / rje gzigs pa lnga ldan/ 'od dpag med/ spyan ras gzigs/ sman bla/kun rig sgrol ma/ gnas brtan bcu drug sogs kyi gyan thang du ma dang / dbus thang tsong kha brgyad cu'i gtsos mkhas pa mi gsum gyi zhal thang / lha lung dpal rdor gyi zhal thang sogs thang ka mang bo dang / sgo khyams su rgyal chen sde bzhi bcas bzhugs/ thugs kyi rten la sngo kyā grags pa rgya mtsho'i sku gdung mchod rten/ rdo ring kha 'jigs med rnam grol gyi sku gdung mchod rten sogs thugs kyi rten mang bo bzhugs/ gsung gi rten la/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur chen mo tshar gcig rje'i gsung 'bum sogs glegs bam mang bo dang / par khang chen mor sman chog chen mo nam mkha'i gtsos kun 62

le'u lnga ba/ bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/rig rnam par snang mdzad/ mgon chos lnga/ chos spyod kyi skor sogs dgon pa 'di'i 'don chog cha tshang bzhugs/ yang rka phug pasnyi ta sku phreng lnga ba blo bzang snyan grags kyi sku ring la rka phug dpon po dang nang 'gal byung nas gnam rdzong bkra shis rnam rgyal gling du phebs te/ phyir rka phug dpon por dmod mo byas nas lnga lam du btang / de'i sdig bshags la khong gis sgo byang du gtad pa'i 'du khang zhig bzhengs shing sku gsung thugs rten gyis phyur bur gtams par byas/ dge ldan bstan rgyas gling zhes mtshan kyang gsol yod mod dus nam bzhengs pa'i lo tshigs dang khong gi mdzad rnam dag gsal kha ma nges pas shin tu phangs/ dgon pa 'di'i bla brang khag ni rka phug parnyi ta'i bla brang / rdo ring kha bla brang / dkar po sprul sku'i bla brang / rka phug zhabs drung bla brang /bis kyā chung ba'i bla brang bcas yod/ 'di'i skabs dgon pa'i lo gcig gi chos thog gi rim pa ni/ zla dang po'i tshes bdun la smon lam yar tshogs dang / tshes brgyad nas bcu bzhi bar nyin bdun la bzang spyod dang mgon chos 'don/ bco lnga'i nyin smon lam yin/ 'cham la mgon po/ chos rgyal gnyis/ tsa murnyi/ lha mo/ k+ṣe tra pa la/ sa 'dul keng rus dang zhwa nag pa/ a tsa ra sogs kyi gar 'cham byed/ bcu drug la byams pa gling skor byas nas grol/ zla gnyis pa'i tshes bco lnga la dus bzang dang / nyer lnga nas kun 63

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/rig sa chog zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum nas nyin bdun la kun rig bdag 'jug tshes dgur sbyin sreg dang / de'i rjes rdul tshon cha 'dren byas nas sgrub mchod grol/ zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu bzhi nas zla bzhi pa'i tshes gcig bar bla ma mchod pa dang sman bla gsungs nas mchod pa 'tshogs/ zla bzhi ba'i tshes bcu gcig nyin nas bcu bdun bar khams ra gle lnga 'khor nas sman bla'i chos thog 'tshogs/ zla lnga ba'i tshes bco lnga la dus bzang 'tshogs/ zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi nyin dge bskos gsar bzhag byed/ de nas gnam rdzong rtser phebs te mchod pa 'tshogs nas phyi dro dgon par log pa dang / phyi nyin nas dge bskos rnying bas rtsis sprod byed/ zla bdun pa'i tshes gcig nas bcu bar mchod pa 'tshogs/ zla brgyad pa'i tshes nyer lngar tshogs mang gis gnam rdzong rtse'i lab tse bstad nas dge 'dun bcu phrag skor gyis rka phug bla brang du mgon po'i gtor sgrub 'don/ zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer gcig nas nyer gsum bar sman chog chen mo dang smon lam srol rgyun ltar gsungs/tshes nyer bdun nas grong sde'i sngags 'du 'tshogs sar phebs nas mgon chos gsungs/ zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bco lnga dang bcu drug la rgyal mchog skal bzang ba'i gdung mchod yin/ zla bcu gnyis par grwa bgres rnams kyis bsnyen mtshams sna tshogs gtong ba dang / grwa gzhon rnams kyis dpe mtshams gang rigs la 64

le'u lnga ba/ bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/bzhugs pa/ skor zhig gis khro bcu'i gtor bzlog dang / yang skor zhig gis lha mo'i gtor sgrub 'tshogs nas tshes bcu dgu la grol/ rnga 'ching 'tshogs nas dgu gtor grub pa na lo gcig 'khor ba'i chos thog rdzogs pa yin la/ gnam lo gsar ba'i tshes gcig la lha mor tshes gtor phul nas gnam lo gsar bzhad la dga' ston byed srol dar yod/rka phug parnyi ta sku phreng rim byon gtso byas bla brang khag gi bla ma rnams kyis brtse gzigs tshad med gnang bas dgon 'di shin tu dar zhing rgyas la stobs shugs dang mnga' dbang che bas/khams ra spyi'i lugs gnyis kyi bya bzhag gang sgrub dgos tshe dgon pa'i grwa rigs tshor 'dri rtog dang gros byed dgos/ de'i dus pho shi rta bo dang mo shi mdzo mo'i bdag po rka phu parnyi ta yin zer zhing /gshin po'i sngas mgor phebs dgos tshe'ang thog mar rka phug tshang dang bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi dge 'dun pa bdun phrag gcig ma zhus gong sngags pa dang btsun ma gang yang zhus pa'i srol dar med/khams ra mi dmangs la skyid sdug ci byung yang nam zhus na dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa tsho de ma thag phebs kyang dgos/ spyir gnam rdzong khor yug sa rgya chung yang khor yug gi sa'i sum cha'i gnyis bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi khongs su gtogs/ rka phug parnyi tas dgon 'di phyag 'debs mdzad pa nas bzung sa mtshams phyes 65

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/yod te/ stod du khams ra'i sngags mang gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling dang dgon pa 'di gnyis kyi bar na 'bum khang zhig yod pa de'i thad drang gi lung ba'i phar kar sha za hor mo'i gzugs kyi brag ri'i man chad bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi sa yin la/ smad du sngon ltar na gnubs sde ba'i thag nye zhig na sa mtshams phyes yod mod/ dgon pa dang gnubs sde ba'i bar sa rtsod byung stabs dgon pa rang ngos nas mchod gzhis lha sde dang rtsod pa byung na mi legs par dgongs nas/ phyir bsnur byas te sdong bo mdze bo zer ba de sa mtshams kyi rdo ring lta bur bzung yod/ de yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ dgon pa'i grwa ba tsho phyogs gzhan la byon te phyir sdong bo mdze bo'i sar thon tshe/ dgon pa'i chos thog 'tshogs pa'i skabs yin na chos gos sdong mgor dpyangs pa dgon pa nas mthong tshe/ dgon pa'i nang khul du bslebs yod pa'i brdar go nas 'grig dang chad pa gang yang 'jal mi dgos/ da lta sdong bo de shul med du gyur yang btsun ma dgon gyi mchod rten cha brgyad yod pa'i gsham gyi lung ba'i mthil der ngos 'dzin thub pas/de'i yan chad bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi sa yin/ gnam rdzong rtse'i mkhas pa mi gsum gyi sgrub phug gtso byas lha khang so sor dgon 'dis bdag gnyer byed dgos shing / dge 'dun pa re nyin rgyun gnam rdzong rtser mchod 'bul du phebs dgos stabs/ de la 66

le'u lnga ba/ bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/zhabs tog gi tshab tu khams ra gle lnga'i khyim re nas gro shing tse gang re 'bul srol 'dug pa dang / dgon pa'i rgya lo'i smon lam dang gsum pa'i mchod pa gnyis kyi chos thog la khams ra ba tshang mas mang ja bskol dgos la/ khyim res mar srang drug re dang / gro shing tse gang re/ nas shing tse gang re bcas lo rgyun ltar 'bul ba'i srol dar yod/ rgyu dngos des ma 'dang ba byung tshe dgon pa'i spyi so nas kha snon byed dgos/ skabs der gnam rdzong rtse'i mkhas pa mi gsum gyi gsang lam de lo ngo stong phrag tsam 'das shing /nyams rgud kyi rnam pa ches cher mngon nas mi rnams bgrod dka' ba byung stabs/ dgon pa'i dge 'dun pa tshos rdo bzo mkhas pa dag glas nas bzos pa'i ljid tshad la spyi rgya brgya phrag lhag yod pa'i rdo them nar mo re re bzhin bgrod dka' ba'i 'gag phreng der drangs te rdo them de dag lam gyi rmang gzhir btings nas zhig gso mdzad pas/ lam bu sngar las zheng tshad che zhing bgrod bde ba zhig byung / phyis su rig gnas gsar brje chen mo'i skabs su'ang grwa rgan tsho mtshan mor gsang stabs kyis phebs nas rdo skas kyi lam bu 'di yang bskyar zhig gso mdzad myong / sngon der gnam sgo zhig bzhengs te gnam rdzong rtse'i mkhas pa mi gsum gyi sgrub phug gtsos lha khang so sor do dam dang bdag gnyer sngar las lhag pa mdzad/gal te gnas ri'i rtser 'gro mi byung tshe skabs de'i rtse'i lha gnyer 67

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/gang yin pa'i dgon pa'i grwa rigs de song nas sgo 'byed pa'i srol dar yod/ dgon 'dir rgyun bzhugs mdzad pa'i dge 'dun yang zhal grangs brgya lhag las brgal mod/ ma pu'u h+phang gis dbang bsgyur pa'i skabs su/ sde dgon so sor khral rigs sna tshogs lci bar brten/ phyogs gzhan nas phebs yong ba'i dge 'dun pa dag lhag par dka' ngal che stabs sprod rgyu ma rnyed par rang yul so sor bsnyegs pas/ yul 'di'i gnyug mar gnas pa sum cu tsam la thug bcings 'grol rjes su sngon rka phug blo bzang don grub kyis bzhengs pa'i 'du khang rka phug parnyi ta sku phreng bdun pa dge 'dun legs bshad rgya mtsho dang / rdzong nang zhabs drung bstan pa rgya mtsho rnam gnyis kyis bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i gdong ngan zhes pa me pho sprel gyi spyi lo1956lor gsar bzhengs mdzad/ rnam 'phyang zhes pa sa pho khyi'i spyi lo1958lor gangs ri'i rgyal bstan spyi la 'pho 'gyur ya nga ba thebs nas/ dgon sde yod do cog gtor bshig btang zhing / rin thang gzhal du med pa'i sku gsung thugs rten mang bo mer bsregs pa dang / chu la bskyur ba sogs sngon glang dar gyi las 'gul slar yang byung ba lta bu byas/ 'di'i skabs su gnam rdzong gi dgon sde so so'i rin thang gzhal du med pa'i sku gsung thugs rten dang rtsa che ba'i lo rgyus yig cha la sogs gong rim gyi las byed mi sna dang / 'go khrid 68

le'u lnga ba/bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/sogs kyis phyogs gcig tu bsdus te/ rma chu'i ral kha brgyud de gzings thog nas gcan tsha rdzong du bskyal skabs/ klu rgyu khug gi brag srin mo nas stabs ma legs par gzings kha lo bsgyur zhing /rten gsum dang dngos po rtsa chen de dag gcig kyang ma lus par rma chu'i klong du nub pa da lta'ang shin tu phangs sems che ba'i gzhi ru gyur/ de nas bgrang bya nyi shu tsam 'das rjes rgyal bstan nyi gzhon gyi 'dzum mdangs slar yang dbang phyogs lhun po'i spo nas mngon tshe/ 'phags pa gnas brtan yan lag 'byung gi sprul ba rdzong nang zhabs drung bstan pa rgya mtsho mchog gis don grub ces pa sa mo lug gi spyi lo1979lor sngon gyi grwa rigs chos 'byor dang /stobs rgyas/ dge slong blo gros rgya mtsho/ dge slong 'jiṭa med rgya mtsho/ sman pa bsam gtan/ sman pa nor bu/ a khu klu sgrub/ dge 'dun dpal bzang / ban de sangs rgyas/ dpal ldan/ phag mo/dge 'byung / bsod nams rab brtan/ tshe ring 'bum soṭa la thugs bkod dang phyag rdzas mang du bstsal ba gzhir byas grwa rigs so sos kyang rgyu dngos phangs med du btang nas rtse'i sgrub phug rnams bskyar bzhengs mdzad de phyi nang gi rten dang brten pa legs grub byung / de yang sngon gyi dus su gtsang dgongs pa rab gsal bzhugs myong ba'i brag phug der nga brgyad yar sngon gyi bzhengs lugs ltar sman 'dam las grub pa'i rje btsun byams pa 69

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/mgon po'i sku brnyan bzhugs/ phyis su bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i dkar po zhes pa sa mo sbrul gyi spyi lo1989lo'i hor zla bdun pa'i tshes bcu gsum nyin gyi zhogs par sku brnyan 'di'i g.yas kyi phyag mthil nas bdud rtsi'i zil ba khrom khrom du babs nas zhabs zung skyil krung dang lte ba'i bar na ltems mer 'khyil zhing dri bzang gis gnas ri yongs su khyab pa byung / dmar shākya mu ne bzhugs myong ba'i brag phug der sngon ltar sman 'dam las grub pa'i rje yab sras gsum dang / g.yas su sngon gyi dus rgya gar nas 'phur 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi li sku gcig bzhugs/ g.yon du sman 'dam las grub pa'i dpal ldan lha mo'i snang brnyan bzhugs/g.yo dge ba'i 'byung gnas bzhugs myong ba'i brag phug der sngon ltar dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi snang brnyan bzhugs/ sngon mkhas pa mi gsum gyi ja khang yin pa'i brag phug der nga brgyad sngon bzhin mkhas pa mi gsum gyi sku brnyan bzhugs/ sgrub phug 'di sngon gyi byin rlabs kyi drod khol ma nyams pa'i brdar/ dgun grang ngar che dus lha khang gzhan dag gi mchod chu la chab rom chags kyang / 'dir chab rom mi chags par ma zad rang bzhin gyis drod khol 'khyil yod/ sngon gnas bdag ma sangs 'gengs pa bzhugs pa'i shul du da lta yang ma sangs rgyal bo'i ldebs bris ha cang gnyan cha che ba zhig bzhugs/ rab byung bcu bdun pa dbu tshugs 70

le'u lnga ba/bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/pa'i me mo yos kyi spyi lo1987lor/ yang rdzong nang zhabs drung bstan pa rgya mtsho rin po che nas dge slong 'jiṭa med rgya mtsho dang /blo gros rgya mtsho/ dge 'dun rgya mtsho soṭa grwa btsun yongs la thugs bkod dang rgyu dngos mang po gnang nas btsan khang bzhengs te/rje gser khang ba'i bzhugs gnas kha sha mthil nas gdan drangs pa'i ma sangs rgyal ba'i zhal thang bzhugs/ phyis su 'jigs rung gi gson nyams ldan pa'i mgon chos lnga'i snang brnyan ldebs bris 'ga' bzhugs su gsol/ btsan khang bzhengs pa'i phyi lo khong rin po che'i thugs bskyed dang grwa btsun bcu phrag lhag gi brtson 'grus dang / khams ra mi dmangs kyi rgyab skyor la brten nas 'du khang gi phyi'i bkod pa'i rmang gzhi nas dbu btsugs te lo gsum gyi ring la phyi nang gi rten dang brten pa yongs su legs 'grub byung /'di'i skabs su sprul sku grol los kyang 'du khang gsar bskrun gyi thebs su ja nag lnga bcu tham pa gnang / nang gi sku'i rten la gser zangs las grub pa'i rje bdag nyid chen mo'i sku brnyan dang /g.yas su li las grub pa'i ston pa gtso 'khor gsum la ston sku lnga brgyas bskor/ g.yon du sman 'dam las grub pa'i rje gser khang ba'i snang brnyan dang ston sku lnga brgya bzhugs/ khyon yongs sman 'dam las grub cing mtho tshad la tshon lnga can gyi thub dbang gi sku stong rtsa gcig bzhugs/ g.yas kyi logs ngos su dpal ldan lha 71

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/mo'i zhal thang dang / sman bla'i gyan thang / gnas brtan bcu drug gi gyan thang bzhugs/ g.yon gyi logs ngos su rje btsun ma'i sku brnyan ldebs bris dang / kun rig gi gyan thang / glo sgo'i steng ngos su rje mi la'i rnam thar las sku brnyan ldebs bris 'ga' bzhugs/gzhan yang thun mong skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing / dben sa snyan brgyud lugs kyi bla ma mchod pa'i tshogs zhing / rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs zhal thang mang bo bzhugs/ gsung gi rten la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur tshar gcig rje'i gsung 'bum sogs glegs bam mang bo bzhugs/ thugs kyi rten la rka phug parnyi ta sku phreng bdun pa dge 'dun legs bshad rgya mtsho'i sku gdung mchod rten/rdzong nang zhabs drung bstan pa rgya mtsho'i sku gdung mchod rten/ sku phyogs dge 'dun rgyal mtshan gyi sku gdung mchod rten bcas bzhugs/ sgo khyams g.yas g.yon gyi ngos gnyis su rgyal chen sde bzhi dang / 'du khang gi mthar ma ṇi 'khor lo mang bo mu khyud du bzhugs su gsol lo/ de ltar dgon pa'i rten bzhengs kyi rim pa mjug legs par grub rjes sngon gyi chos thog kha shas gsar 'dzugs gnang yod de/ hor zla dang po'i tshes bdun nas bcu drug bar smon lam dang mgon chos lnga srol rgyun ltar gsungs/ zla gsum pa'i tshes gsum nas bdun bar rje gser khang bas btsugs pa'i mchod pa 'tshogs dgos la tshes bdun nas bcu 72

le'u lnga ba/ bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/ bar kun rig rnam par snang mdzad gsungs nas bdag 'jug len dgos/ zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi nyin gnam rdzong rtse'i mkhas pa mi gsum sgrub phug tu mchod pa 'tshogs dgos/ zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer gcig nas nyer gsum bar smon lam sna lnga dang sman chog chen mo gsungs dgos/ zla bcu ba'i tshes nyer bzhi nas nyer bdun par rje bdag nyid chen mo'i gdung mchod 'tshogs dgos/ de ltar lo 'khor hril bo gcig ring gi chos thog gang bzhugs kyi 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen dge 'dun pa res lo rer thugs 'gan bzhes te khams ra gle lngar zhal 'debs bslangs nas chos thog gi 'tsho ba sbyor ba'i srol dar yod/ zla rer dge 'dun pa res dgon pa'i 'du khang dang / btsan khang chen mo/ gnam rdzong rtse'i mkhas pa mi gsum gyi sgrub phug rnams su mchod 'bul dang bdag gnyer byed par nyin rgyun chad med du phebs dgos/ 'di'i skabs su yar nang sngags khang dang zangs mdog dpal ri'i sgrub phug gnyis la yang mchod 'bul dang bdag gnyer byed dgos stabs/ de'i zhabs tog gi tshab tu gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling nas chos thog gi skabs su gor skal dang mar skal re ster srol yod/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me mo yos kyi spyi lo1987lor mkhas shing grub pa'i go 'phang la mngon par 'phags pa'i nges pa don gyi sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ba chen mo sku phyogs ske kyā rin po che lo de'i hor zla 73

oṃchung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/bzhi ba'i tshes brgyad nyin gser khang ri khrod nas gsang stabs kyis gnam rdzong rtser zhabs sor bkod de sbas tshul gyis bzhugs shing / hor zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi nyin mkhas pa mi gsum gyi sgrub phug nas bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi dge 'dun pa yongs la sman chog chen mo dang / bla ma mchod pa/ smon lam sna lnga bcas kyi ljags lung bstsal/ dkar bo zhes pa sa mo sbrul gyi spyi lo1989lor rdo ring kha ba'i sprul sku dge 'dun rgyal mtshan tshang khrir bzhugs nas/ dge 'dun pa rnams la khri 'gyed dang /dgon pa'i gzhung la dngos rdzas gya nom pa gnang ste sgrig lam kun spyod dang bslab pa slob gnyer byed dgos pa'i gsung gleng rin thang dang bral ba bstsal/ rab byung bcu bdun pa'i rab myos zhes pa lcags pho rta yi spyi lo1990lor rka phug parnyi ta sku phreng brgyad pa bstan 'dzin dkon mchog rin po che rdzong nang dgon gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling nas nyid kyi yongs 'dzin dam pa dang lhan du zhabs zung 'khor lo'i mtshan ris bkra shis rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i khri 'phang la mngon par bkod de/ dge 'dun pa rnams la khri 'gyed dang / dgon pa'i gzhung la rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku brnyan byin can zhig rten skal du gnang zhing / phyogs 'dus dad ldan yongs la skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa dang / dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa/ 'pho lung sogs bstsal/74

le'u lnga ba/bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/rab byung bcu bdun pa'i dpal gdong zhes pa chu mo bya yi spyi lo1993lo'i hor zla dgu pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin sku phyogs ske kyā rin po che yang bskyar gnam rdzong la zhabs btegs te bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi khrir bzhugs shing / dge 'dun pa tshor dmangs sgor bcu re'i khri 'gyed dang / 'du khang dang btsan khang gnyis la rab gnas kyi byin chen phabs te/ zla gsum lhag gi ring rka phug bla brang du bzhugs nas dge 'dun pa rnams la lung bka' chos mang du gnang / na tshod ldan zhes pa shing mo phag gi spyi lo1995lo'i hor zla bzhi ba'i nang mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa'i mkhas pa'i dbang bo rje shar gdong blo bzang bshad sgrub rgya mtsho rin po che dgon 'dir zhabs zung gi re khā mngon par bkod de/ yul 'di'i skya ser pho mo yongs la thugs rje chen po bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang dang / rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang / 'jigs byed dpa' gcig gi dbang gnang zhing /skyabs khrid/ smon lam sna lnga/ rdo rje gcod pa/ 'pho lung / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ rigs gsum mgon po sogs kyi gzungs sngags zab mo mang bo'i ljags lung gnang / 'bru mang po zhes pa sa pho stag gi spyi lo1998lor dgon pa'i byang skyor mchod rten bzhengs bskrun gyi dbu btsugs te/ bgrang bya gsum gyi ring tshegs brtson 'grus lhod med byas mthar/ bongs tshod la khri tshad 75

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/drug cu re gsum longs pa'i mthong grol dus 'khor mchod rten chen mo bkra shis rten 'brel gyi mtshan ma 'bum dang bcas legs grub byung / nang rten la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku brnyan 'bum phrag par te bzhugs pa dang / li las grub pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad kyi sku brnyan gcig slob dpon rin po che'i dbu skra/ rje mi la ras pa'i sgom thag rgya bod bal gsum gyi rten 'dus rtsa chen mang bo/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur chen mo tshar gnyis/ yum 'bum pa tshar gsum/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud tshar gcig gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud tshar gcig 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud tshar gcig dus 'khor rtsa rgyud tshar gcig rje yab sras gsung 'bum cha tshang / sman mdo brgyad brgya ba/ thar mdo chen mo/ sdig bshags gser gyi spu gri stong tshar/ smon lam sna lnga sogs mdo sngags kyi gsung rab mang po bzhugs su gsol te/ sprul sku grol lo rin po che dang rka phug partsi ta bstan 'dzin dkon mchog rnam gnyis snga phyir spyan drangs nas bkra shis rab gnas kyi byin chen dngos su phabs/ de nas sa skyong zhes pa shing mo bya yi spyi lo2005lor gnam rdzong rtse'i mkhas mi gsum gyi sgrub phug gi phyi'i bkod pa bskyar bzhengs kyi dbu btsugs te/ lo gnyis kyi ring phyi'i bkod pa'i rnam pa khyon yongs shing las grub cing klad du gyo thog gis brgyan te/ chos 'khor/ ri dwags pho mo/ rgyal mtshan dang bcas pas legs par spras nas 76

le'u lnga ba/ bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/brjid nyams ldan pa'i lha khang 'di nyid dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i mig gi dpal du shar/ nang gi rten la sngon bzhengs yod pa'i sku brnyan dag gzhir byas sman 'dam las grub pa'i yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ dam can chos rgyal/ rnam thos sras/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ gsang bdag 'khor chen/rta mgrin gsang sgrub/ dam can skyes bu chen po/ nye ba'i sras chen brgyad tshar gnyis/ dbyangs can ma'i li sku/ rdo rje sems dpa'i li sku/ o rgyan snang srid zil gnon li sku/ sngon bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal bzhugs par grags pa'i phug pa der shing brkos las grub pa'i rje btsun mi la ras pa'i sku brnyan dang / 'od dpag med kyi zhing thang / tshe dpag med kyi zhal thang / mnyam med thub pa'i dbang bo'i zhal thang / rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi zhal thang /rje bdag nyid chen mo'i zhal thang bcas rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' dang yi dam chos skyong la sogs pa'i sku brnyan mang po bzhugs su gsol nas skye 'gro'i bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing gi mchog tu gyur / de ltar bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi dge 'dun pa tshos sngon nas da lta'i bar lo ngo stong phrag lhag 'gor ba'i nang bstan rig gnas lo rgyus kyi rin thang ldan zhing / byin rlabs kyi tshan kha gzhan las mtho ba'i bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum sgrub phug gi rten dang brten pa yang dang bskyar du zhig gsos dang / do 77

oṃchung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/dam bdag gnyer lhod med du bgyis shing / gnam rdzong khor yug gi ri chu nags gsum dang / ri skyes srog chags yongs la dus dang rnam pa kun tu srung skyob byed pa dang / 'cham mthun spyi tshogs 'dzugs sgrun byed par sa gnas mang tshogs dang mnyam 'brel byas te gong rim srid gzhung gi rlabs che ba'i mdzub ston la gzhogs 'degs dang slob sbyong byed cing / lhag par du rje gsar khang rin po che dang rka phug pasnyi ta sku phreng rim byon rnams kyi gtsos mkhas grub gnyis 'dzoms kyi bla ma dam pa dag gi thugs kyi bskyed pa chud mi 'dza' ba'i mthu las/ zhwa ser rang lugs 'dzin pa'i dpal ri bo dge ldan pa'i dgon chung 'di sngon gyi phyag srol bzang bo ji bzhin sgrub pa nyams len dang / thos bsam sgom gsum/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi rnam thar gtsang ma'i rgyun skyong bzhin bzhugs pa'i skabs lags so/ /smras pa/ blo chen kun bzang donu kun gruṭā dang gser khang snya ma'i thugs bskyed kyis/ /'khor 'das gdung sel bkra shi sa dpal g.yang rang byung sul du gnas bcas pa'i/ /mkha' khyab skye rgu'i rnam grol gnyer sa'i chos kyi rgyal mtshan mtho ba'i sde/ /srid zhi'i rgyarde pa sel ba'i gnyen por blange bzhi'i mchod sdong gcig pur grub/ / d+ngha78

le'u drug pa/ bsam gtan 'phel rgyas gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/le'u drug pa/ bsam gtan 'phel rgyas gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/gnam rdzong btsun ma dgon bsam gtan 'phel rgyas gling ni/gna' rabs kyi ngag rgyun du/ rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i dkyil stod tsam zhig la/ khams ra'i rdzong chen bco brgyad kyi ya gyal jo mo rdzong gi sgrub khang na btsun ma ye shes sgron ma dpon slob gnyis kyis yun ring sgrub pa byas nas mthar rags sku'i za ma tog ma spangs bzhin du mkha' spyod du gshegs par grags/ dus phyis su rnga rdzong nas btsun ma dgon dar ba yin mod/ gnas de'i sa bkra mi legs par gleng nas gnam rdzong gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling gi gsham du gnas spo byas yong ba yin/ de'i dus su btsun ma rnams rang ngos nas 'du khang med stabs/ tshogs pa khams ra'i sngags mang gzhung gi 'du khang chung bar 'tshogs dgos pas/btsun ma rnams kyis dgu rong sna tshogs rang grol tshang la dgon gzhi gsar ba zhig gi gnas yul gzigs par zhus pas/ khong gis bod rab byung bco lnga ba'i rab myos zhes pa spyi lo1870lor mchod rten thang bya ba sa'i chags dbyibs rma bya phyir 'khor gyis sgro gdugs phub pa lta bu'i dbus su gnam rdzong btsun ma dgon 79

rnyospochung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/ bsam gtan 'phel rgyas gling phyag 'debs mdzad cing / dgon pa'i mthar 'bum khang brgyad bzhengs te/ btsun ma brgya kha 'du zhing btsun ma'i bstan pa rgyas pa yin zhes zhal g.yang lung bstan gnang zhing / dam chos bdud rtsi mngar mos yun ring bskyangs pas thugs mthun khrims gtsang gi sgrub dgon khyad par ba zhig tu gyur/ sgyur byed ces pa sa mo phag gi spyi lo 1899lor dgu sprul o rgyan 'jigs bral chos dbyings rdo rjes 'du khang gyo thog gis brgyan te bskyar bzhengs gnang / nang rten du slob dpon gtso 'khor gsum dang / rta phag yid bzhin nor bu/ 'jigs bral chos dbyings rdo rje'i 'dra sku bcas pa nang rten gyi gtso bo yin la/gzhan bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan sna tshogs dang gyan thang yang mang bo bzhugs/ gsung gi rten la yum 'bum pa sogs glegs bam du ma dang / thugs kyi rten la mchod rten cha brgyad sogs bzhugs/mchod cha'i rigs la/ mkhar rnga/ dung / rgya gling / tsen/ sbub cha sogs mchod chas du ma dang / mchod phreng bcu drug gtsags drub ma sogs mchod rdzas mang bo bzhugs yod pa dang / 'du khang gi mthar ma ṇi 'khor lo mang bos bskor ba sogs rten bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhugs/ btsun ma drug cu nas bdun cu tsam 'phel/de'i dus dgu sprul o rgyan 'jigs bral chos dbyings rdo rjesadagu sprul bca' yig)ces pa gsar rtsom gnang ste/ chos thog sgrig 80

le'u drug pa/bsam gtan 'phel rgyas gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/lam sogs sngar las 'thus tshang du btang zhing / snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i chos rgyun rgya cher spel te lugs gnyis kyis 'dzin skyong bla med gnang / gzhan yang dgon 'dir rdzogs chen chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rje dang / rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel sogs mdo dbus khams gsum gyi skyes bu mang bo byon nas snga 'gyur ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i zab chos mang du spel bas/ mdo smad phyogs nas snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i btsun ma'i sgrub dgon ming grags can zhig tu gyur/ rnam 'phyang zhes pa sa pho khyi'i spyi lo1958lor rgyal bstan zla gzhon gyi lang tsho gnam stong mal du gzim pa'i skabs/ mi bsrun brlang spyod la goms pa'i ma rung skyes bo'i tshogs kyis sku gsung sum̐gs gsum gyi rten sna mang bo brlag nyes dang 'du khang la sogs gtor bshig btang nas dgon pa'i shul tsam las mi snang bar byas nas bgrang bya nyi shu lhag 'das/ de nas chos lugs dad mos kyi srid jus slar yang mngon pa dang bstun nas don grub ces pa sa mo lug gi spyi lo1979lor/rdzong nang zhabs drung bstan pa rgya mtsho rin po che dang dgu rong rgyal sras rnam gnyis kyis phyag rdzas mang du bstsal ba gzhir byas/sprul sku grol lo rin po ches thugs bkod gnang ste a ne byams pa dbang mo/ bsam gtan dbang mo/ chos sgron/ bde sgron/ a ne rig 'dzin/ lha lcam sogs kyis mtshon btsun ma yongs dang /81

bhāchung gsab rdzong gi lo rgyugakhams ra gle lnga'i rgyab skyon la brten nas yang bskyar 'du khang chen mo'i phyi'i bkod pa yongs su grub/ nang gi sku'i rten la slob dpon rin po che gtso sku byas te g.yas su 'jam pa'i dbyangs/g.yon du rje btsun sgrol ma/ g.yas kyi logs ngos su gnas brtan bcu drug gi gyan thang dang / 'od dpag med kyi zhing thang /spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong gi gyan thang / g.yon gyi logs ngos su rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i gyan thang dang / zangs mdog dpal ri'i zhing bkod/ gdugs dkar bcas kyi gyan thang bzhugs/ gzhan yang rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi zhal thang dang /gu ru mtshan brgyad/ phur ba/ zhi khro/ mkha' 'gro bde chen rgyal mo bcas kyi zhal thang dang bshags lha so lnga sogs ldebs bris mang bo bzhugs/ gsung gi rten la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur chen mo dang bstan 'gyur/ rnying ma'i rgyud 'bum/ klong chen mdzod bdun sogs glegs bam mang bo bzhugs/ thugs kyi rten la dgon pa'i byang skyor du byang chub mchod rten chen mo dang / nub kyi phyogs su mchod rten cha brgyad/ 'du khang gi mthar ma ṇi 'khor lo mang bo mu khyud du bzhugs su gsol lo/ /dgon 'dir rgyun bzhugs gnang ba'i btsun ma brgya dang bdun cu lhag tu 'phel zhing chos thog 'tshogs pa'i skabs 'du khang gi nang du shong dka' bas/ bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i mi zad ces pa me pho 82

le'u drug pa/bsam gtan 'phel rgyaspogling gi byung tshul bshad pa/khyi'i spyi lo2006lor/ mdo smad phyogs kyi snga 'gyur rnying ma'i rgyal bstan gyi srog shing gcig pu yul 'di'i lugs gnyis kyi spyi bdag chen po sprul sku grol lo mchog gis thugs bkod dang / rgyu dngos spam mtho ba mang bo dang kar sha pa ne'i tshab byed da lta'i dmangs sgor 'bum phrag 'ga' bstsal nas/ zur bzhi gling brgyad kyi mtshan ma mngon par dod pa'i mthong grol 'du khang chen mo yongs su legs 'grub byung / nang gi rten bzhengs kyi rim pa ni/ steng khang gi gtso sku la sman 'dam las grub pa'i mnyam med thub pa'i dbang bo dang / g.yas su 'jam pa'i dbyangs/g.yon du spyan ras gzigs/ gyan thang gi skor la/ g.yas su 'jigs med gling ba'i 'khrungs rabs dang gnas brtan bcu drug logs ngos su phur drag bcas bzhugs/ g.yon du skyabs mgon zhabs dkar ba'i 'khrungs rabs dang rta phag yid bzhin nor bu/ logs ngos su bshags lha so lnga bcas bzhugs/ 'og khang gi gtso sku la sman 'dam las grub pa'i slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ g.yas su mkhan chen bornyi sa twa dang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che bzhugs/ g.yon du sman 'dam las grub pa'i chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang bstan 'gyur bzhugs/ gyan thang gi skor la/ g.yas su skyabs 'gro'i tshogs zhing / logs ngos su klong snying sdug bsngal rang grol/ phur ba bdud dpung zil gnon/83

achung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/dpal chen phyag rgya rgyas pa/ rta khyung / chos skyong chen po/ sgo rgyab kyi nang logs su ma mgon sde lnga bcas bzhugs/ g.yon du bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa/ logs ngos su ston pa'i mdzad chen bcu gnyis/ kar gling zhi ba/ kar gling khro bo/ rta mgrin/sgrol ma nyer gcig sgo rgyab kyi nang logs su dpal ldan lha mo bcas bzhugs su gsol lo/ /lo 'khor hril bo gcig ring gi chos thog gi rim pa ni/ cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes gcig nas lnga bar rig 'dzin tshe sgrub dang / tshes bdun nas bcu gsum par bshags pa'i rgyal bo yi ge brgya ba la brten nas rdor sems kyi sbyin sreg hor zla gsum pa'i tshes nyer gsum nas nyer dgu bar bla mchod chos thog hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes gcig nas tshes gsum bar rta phag yid bzhin nor bu'i chos thog hor zla bzhi ba'i tshes bcu bzhi nas nyi shu bar zhi khro'i chos thog zla bzhi ba'i tshes nyer gcig nas nyer gsum par sgyung gnas chos thog zla lnga ba'i tshes bcu bzhi nas bcu drug bar bde chen zhing sgrub/ zla brgyad pa'i tshes gcig nas tshes lnga bar snga dro bla mchod dang phyi dro phur ba 'don/ zla dgu ba'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin rig 'dzin gyi tshogs 'khor bskor/ zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bco brgyad nyin yang gsang bla sgrub dang zla re'i yar ngo rig 'dzin gyi tshogs dang mar ngo la mkha' 'gro'i tshogs mchod dgos/ de ltar lo gcig gi 84

le'u drug pa/bsam gtan 'phel rgyas gling gi byung tshul bshad pa/chos thog gang bzhugs kyi 'tsho ba'i thebs su lo rer btsun ma gsum res dad ldan rnams la zhal 'debs bslangs nas mthun rkyen sbyor ba'i srol dar yod/ dgu rong sku phreng snga phyi'i thugs bskyed dang gzhan nas phebs pa'i snga 'gyur rnying ma ba'i bla chen dag dang / khyad par du dgon 'dir thog mtha' bar gsum du brtse gzigs tshad med gnang ba'i sprul sku grol lo sogs kyi thugs rje la brten nas dgon pa 'di shin tu dar zhing rgyas te/ btsun ma rnams kyi sgrig lam kun spyod mdzes shing / 'don rta dbyangs dang / rdung rol mo/ cho ga'i rim pa la sogs pa'i phyag len ha cang zhib rgyas dang 'thus tshang yin pas dad ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i yul dam par gyur/ dus rgyun btsun ma yongs kyis bsags sbyang gi gnad la brtson zhing / mdo sngags rig gnas spyi la thos pa byed pa dang / sgos su 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i rnal 'byor la nyin mtshan khor mo yug tu brtson bzhin pa lags so/ /smras pa/ dgu sprul bla ma'i rmad byung thugs bskyed lha lam mdzes ma'i bzhin yangs las/ /bsam gtan dgra yi 'du 'dzi'i sprin dang yongs bral zla gzhon lang tsho'i cha/d+ngha/gsang chen theg rtse'i chos kyi snying bor 'phyel zhing rgyas pa'i dge mtshan gyis/ /gangs can mun gling gsal bar mdzad ces lha mi stong gis had de gzigs/ /d+ngha85

7chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyugale'u bdun pa/ gsar rnying ris med kyi mkhas grub mang bos bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad tshul/ sngon gyi dus btsan po glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs rjes/bod kyi mkhas pa mi gsum dang lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje spyi lo905yas mas su a chung gnam rdzong gi gnas 'dir byon nas/bgrang bya nyi shu rtsa stod lhag gi ring la chos 'chad nyan dang sgrub pa nyams bzhes mdzad nas da lta'i bar lo ngo1102tsam 'das/'di'i ring la mdo dbus khams gsum nas phebs pa'i ris med grub mtha' yongs kyi mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi dam pa mang bos gnas 'di byin gyis brlabs shing zhabs kyis bcags pa'i tshul re re bzhin brjod pa'i yul las 'das mod/ de dag las nyung tsam zhus na/ lha ldan skyid shod sde ba chos rje bstan 'dzin blo bzang rgya mtsho mdo smad du byon nas brag bya khyung du bzhugs skabs/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i dngos po zhes pa shing pho khyi yi spyi lo1634lor ched du a chung gnam rdzong la phebs nas rten rnams la zhib tu mjal zhing gnas 'brel bzhag bkra shis thang 86

le'u bdun pa/ gsar rnying mkhas grub mang bos bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel tshul/nas gnubs khams ra ba sogs kyi skya ser dad ldan yongs la thugs rje chen po'i dbang dang / lung khrid mang bo gnang /de'i rjes su mdo smad kyi sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag yab rje bla ma shar skal ldan rgya mtsho tshang 'dzin byed ces pa me pho byi'i spyi lo1636nas sa skyong zhes pa shing mo bya yi spyi lo1645lo'i bar gnam rdzong rtse dang lha lung dpal rdor gyi sgrub phug gnyis nas res mos su bzhugs te sgrub pa nyams bzhes mdzad pa rnam thar dang ngag rgyun gnyis kar gsal/ de'i rjes su ko'u ba dka' bcu ba chos rgya mtsho tshang khrag skyug ces pa chu mo phag gi spyi lo1683lor sku 'bum khri zur nas skar ma thang dang / a chung gnam rdzong du phebs nas mgon po rdzong dang / gnam rdzong rtse'i mkhas pa mi gsum gyi sgrub phug sogs su yun ring bzhugs nas sgom sgrub nyams len gnang / rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i myos byed ces pa shing mo lug gi spyi lo1715lor rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtsho sku na phra dus mtsho sngon du bzhugs skabs/ rma chu'i lho byang gi rgyud la gsang stabs kyis phebs nas a chung gnam rdzong du gnas mjal gzigs skor gnang / spre'u zhes pa me mo lug gi spyi lo1727nas drag po zhes pa lcags pho sprel gyi spyi lo1740lo'i bar/ reb gong sngags 'chang phur thogs stong dang dgu brgya'i rmang 'ding mkhan rlangs bla ma rig 87

ma chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/'dzin dpal ldan bkra shis mchog rma chu'i lho byang gnyis su phebs nas/ gang la gang 'tsham gyis chos kyi sbyin pa rgya cher mdzad pa'i skabs a chung gnam rdzong du zhabs sor bkod de/ gnas 'brel bzhag cing / khams ra'i sngags mang la rig 'dzin gdung sgrub dang tshes bcu chos thog gi skor mang po btsugs nas thugs brtse ba bla lhag gis bskyangs/ rab byung bcu gsum pa'i sna tshogs dbyig ces pa shing mo sbrul gyi spyi lo1785lor mdo smad kyi ma hā parnyi ta gsum gyi ya gyal rka phug parnyi ta blo bzang don grub mchog gis gnam rdzong bkra shis thang nas de ga'i ri khrod pa rnams dang bya khyung gi rgyud grwa ba rnams la dbang lung khrid gsum sogs lung bka' chos mang du gnang / rab byung bcu bzhi ba'i dkar po zhes pa sa mo sbrul gyi spyi lo1809lor chos rje gser khang rin po che gnam rdzong rtser byon nas sgom sgrub nyams bzhes mdzad cing /bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi dge 'dun pa tshor lam sngags gnyis dang / myur lam gyi zab khrid/ phyag rgya chen po'i ljags khrid bstsal zhing / ting phor dang mchod thebs mang bo gnang ste lo rer mchod pa 'bum phrag lhag 'bul ba'i srol btsugs/ dngos po zhes pa shing pho khyi yi spyi lo1814lor gnubs khams ra sngags mang gis spyan drangs pa ltar lcang lung dpal chen nam mkha' 'jigs med gnas 'dir phebs nas/ thugs rje chen po 'khor 88

le'u bdun pa/ gsar rnying mkhas grub mang bos bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel tshul/ba dbyings sgrol gyi dbang lung gnang zhing / ma ṇi sgrub chen gsar 'dzugs byas/ gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling zhabs kyis bcags te 'du khang bzhengs pa'i thugs bkod gnang / de'i rjes khong gi thugs kyi sprul ba dgu rong sna tshogs rang grol tshang yang gnas 'dir byon nas/ gnam rdzong rtser lo gcig gi ring rta mgrin yang gsang gi bsnyen sgrub la bzhugs nas sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan mthon por bsgrengs/ mdzes byed ces pa chu mo yos kyi spyi lo 1843lor chos rje gser khang rin po che yang bskyar gnas 'dir zhabs btegs nas/ zab mo ting 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor la gcig tu gzhol nas yun ring bzhugs/ gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling la tshes bcu'i thebs rtsa gnang / bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi dge 'dun pa rnams la kun rig gi dbang dang bka' chos mang bo gnang zhing / gnubs khams ra gle lnga'i sde ba so sor phebs nas thugs rje chen po'i rjes gnang bstsal te lo rer mchod pa bye ba re dang ma ṇi yig drug dung phyur mang bo sgrub pa'i srol btsugs nas phan bde legs tshogs kyi lam bzang gsal bar mdzad/ 'di'i snga phyi du zhabs dkar tshogs drug rang grol tshang khri ka'i phyogs nas gnas 'dir zhabs sor bkod de/ dgun khar gnam rdzong rtser sku mtshams la bzhugs shing / (gnas bstod dngos grub 'byung gnagazhes pa nyams mgur du gyer/89

spochung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/de'i dus khong gi thugs bzhed ltar gnam rdzong rtse'i gong gi brag phug tu gnubs khams ra sngags mang gis zangs mdog dpal ri'i zhing bkod cig bzhengs nas legs par grub/ de'i rjes gnubs khams ra nang skyes kyi grub brnyes rig 'dzin dbang bo bla ma chos dbyings rang grol tshang dang / khong gi thugs sras sprul sku 'jigs med rnam grol dpon slob gnyis gnam rdzong rtse dang mgon po rdzong sogs su bgrang bya mang bo'i ring la zab don a ti yo ga'i mnyam bzhag la goms pa'i rgyun bsrings shing / phyogs med skal ldan gyi bu slob mang bo bskyangs nas bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad/ rab byung bco lnga ba'i zil gnon zhes pa me pho rta yi spyi lo1906lor dgu rong sna tshogs rang grol gyi yang sprul o rgyan 'jigs bral chos dbyings rdo rje mchog gnas 'dir zhabs zung bsgyur te/ gnubs khams ra sngags mang dang / do kya'i sngags mang / khri ka'i ske ba sngags mang bcas la gu ru sirdzi'i sgrub chen gyi chos thog btsugs shing / snying thig pod gnyis sogs kyi dbang lung mang bo gnang / gnam rdzong rtser 'khor 'dus pa mang bo la 'chad khrid mang du mdzad cing / 'od gsal rdzogs pa chen po'i zab gsang ting 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor la gzhol nas yun ring bzhugs/ bag med ces pa chu mo glang gi spyi lo1913lor gter ston bsod rgyal rin po ches gnas 'dir 90

le'u bdun pa/gsar rnying mkhas grub mang bos bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel tshul/zhabs kyis bcags te/ gnam rdzong rtser gnubs khams ra'i sngags pa yongs la sgyu 'phrul gsang ba snying bo'i dbang dang / mi pham bder gshegs stong thun/ 'jam dpal rdzogs pa chen po'i gzhi lam 'bras bu'i zab khrid gnang zhing sgrub pa nyams bzhes mdzad nas yun ring bzhugs/ zhabs dkar rin po che 'jigs med theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan nas rdzogs chen sku phreng bzhi ba thub bstan chos kyi rdo rje spyan drangs nas gnam rdzong du byon cing / gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling zhabs kyis bcags te gnubs khams ra'i sngags pa yongs la rin chen gter mdzod kyi dbang dang lung khrid mang bo bstsal/ gnam rdzong rtser phebs te gnas mjal dang sgrub pa nyams bzhes mdzad nas bzhugs/dga' ba zhes pa chu pho 'brug gi spyi lo1952lor brag khang dge bshes skal bzang rin po che tshang gnam rdzong rtser phebs nas/bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi dge slong klu sgrub gtso byas chos 'byor dang bsam gtan/ stobs rgyas/ nor bu sogs dge 'dun pa yongs la sum rtags dag gsum dang / bla ma mchod pa'i ljags khrid/ lam rim blo sbyong / sa lam rnam bzhag sogs lung khrid mang bo gnang nas yun ring bzhugs/ gzhan yang rdzogs chen chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rje dang / rdzogs chen ma rig mun sel/'jigs med 'od gsal rdo rje'am yongs grags su a lags tshe 91

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/thar tshang / rlangs bla ma rig 'dzin dpal ldan bkra shis kyi yang sprul te reb gong zho 'ong gnyan rgya'i bla ma shes rab rgyal mtshan sogs kyis mtshon gsar rnying ris med kyi skyes chen dam pa rnams gnas 'dir byon nas/ chos 'chad nyan dang thugs dam nyams bzhes mdzad de bshad sgrub lung rtogs kyi rta ljang gzhon nu dus mtha'i lha lam mdzes ma'i mthongs su drangs/ bstan pa yang dar gyi rjes su yang rab byung bcu bdun pa'i me mo yos kyi spyi lo1987lor/ gangs can mi la bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang mi gnyis pa sku phyogs ske kyā rin po che gser khang ri khrod nas gsang stabs kyis gnam rdzong rtser byon nas/ mkhas pa mi gsum sgrub phug tu bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi dge 'dun pa tshor sman chog chen mo dang / bla ma mchod pa/ smon lam sna lnga bcas kyi bklags lung bstsal zhing / lha sngags bde ba chen po'i ting 'dzin gyi rgyun bskyangs nas yun ring bzhugs/ rnam 'byung zhes pa sa pho 'brug gi spyi lo1988lo'i ston zla bdun pa'i nang sku 'bum byams pa gling gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen mo/ rje btsun bla ma blo bzang rdo rje tshang gnam rdzong rtser phebs nas gnas 'brel gzigs skor gnang / dkar po zhes pa sa mo sbrul gyi spyi lo1989lor rdo ring kha ba'i sprul sku'am bshad tshul gzhan zhig la gter ston bsod rgyal rin po che'i sku skyes dge 'dun rgyal mtshan tshang gnam rdzong 92

le'u bdun pa/ gsar rnying mkhas grub mang bos bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel tshul/rtser phebs nas ris med bstan pa rgyas pa'i thugs smon rgya cher mdzad cing / bkra shis rnam rgyal gling zhabs kyis bcags te thugs rjes brtse gzigs bla na med pa mdzad/ rab myos zhes pa lcags pho rta yi spyi lo1990lor rka phug partsi ta sku phreng brgyad pa bstan 'dzin dkon mchog rin po che khong gi yongs 'dzin dang lhan du gnam rdzong bkra shis rnam rgyal gling gi khri 'phang la mnga' gsol te/ phyogs 'dus dad ldan pho mo yongs la skyabs 'gro'i sdom pa dang / dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa/ 'pho lung sogs lung bka' chos mang du gnang / dpal gdong zhes pa chu mo bya yi spyi lo1993lor sku phyogs ske kyā rin po che yang bskyar gnam rdzong la zhabs btegs nas bkra shis rnam rgyal gling du zla gsum gyi ring la sgrub pa nyams bzhes mdzad bzhin dge 'dun pa tshor bka' chos mang du gnang / na tshod ldan zhes pa shing mo phag gi spyi lo1995lor mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtshor gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i ma hā parnyi ta rje shar gdong blo bzang bshad sgrub rgya mtsho rin po che bkra shis rnam rgyal gling du zhabs sor bkod de/dad ldan ser skya pho mo yongs la spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal gyi dbang dang / rta mgrin gsang sgrub kyi dbang / 'jigs byed dpa' gcig gi dbang sogs gnang zhing / skyabs khrid/ smon lam sna lnga/ rdo rje gcod pa/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ 'pho 93

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/lung / rigs gsum mgon po sogs gzungs sngags mang bo'i ljags lung bstsal/ nyi sgrol byed ces pa shing pho sprel gyi spyi lo2004lor sprul sku grol lo rin po ches thugs kyi bskyed pa rlabs chen mdzad de/ slob dpon rin po che'i 'das 'khrungs zung gi dus tshes khyad par can la khong nyid gtsos rdo grub sprul sku klong yangs tshang dang / 'ja' lus pa mkhan chen tshe dbang rig 'dzin rin po che'i yang sprul bstan 'dzin snyan grags tshang /rdzogs chen chos dbyings stobs ldan rdo rje'i yang sprul 'jigs med chos dbyings rang grol rdo rje sogs mkhan sprul bzhi bcu lhag dang / mdo dbus khams gsum nas phebs pa'i rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bzhi stong lhag gis gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling nas nyin bdun gyi ring la rig 'dzin 'bum tshogs chen mo'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor/ yang mi zad ces pa me pho khyi yi spyi lo2006lor sprul sku grol lo rin po ches lugs gnyis kyi thugs khur zab bzhes gnang ste/ gangs ljongs smra ba'i dbang phyug mkhan chen tshul khrims blo gros gtsos grub mtha' ris med kyi bla sprul mang bo dang / phyogs yongs nas phebs pa'i ngur smrig rgyal mtshan gsol ba'i rab byung gi sde dang / gos dkar lcang lo can gyi rig 'dzin sngags 'chang sogs mi grangs lnga stong lhag gis bzang bo spyod pa'i smon lam gyi rgyal bo grangs tshad 'bum phrag tsam 94

le'u bdun pa/ gsar rnying mkhas grub mang bos bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa spel tshugagyis mtshams sbyar te gangs ljongs smon lam thengs gsum pa'i chos tshogs chen mo gsang sngags bstan rgyas gling nas 'tshogs pa dang / chos mtshams rnams su mkhan dam pa tshul khrims blo gros mchog gis dad ldan khyim pa yongs la skyabs 'gro dang / dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bstsal zhing / bde ba can du skye ba'i rgyu bzhi'i ljags khrid zhib cing rgyas pa bstsal/ de ltar phyis dar bstan pa'i chu mgo mdo smad a chung gnam rdzong 'dir dben pa'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing / gnas kyis gang zag byin gyis brlabs pa'i khyad chos dang / rang byung brag ri dang nags tshul mang bos mtha' bskor zhing / khu byug 'jol mo sogs bya rigs mang bos skad snyan 'byin pa/ dwangs shing gtsang ba'i yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu phran thams cad lha mi'i yon chab tu gtams pa'i dge mtshan stong gi dpal yon gyis/ sngon nas da lta'i bar du gsar rnying ris med kyi mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes bu bgrang las 'das pa zhig gnas 'dir byon nas bshad sgrub lung rtogs kyi rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do/ /smras pa/ ris med mkhas grub gser ri'i phreng ba'i zhabs zung 'khor lo'i re khā 'bum/ /thub pa'i bsod nams gnam gyi mthongs las gnam mchog gang la 'phos pa las/ /bdud sde mun 95
pa'i khung bur yib cing dkar phyogs skyong rnams spobs pa rgyas/ /sa la mya ngan med pa'i dpal byin bshad sgrub chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs/ /

zhar byung / a chung gnam rdzong gi mchod gzhis lha sde skor rags tsam brjod pa/zhar byung / a chung gnam rdzong gi mchod gzhis lha sde skor rags tsam brjod pa/rang rgyal gyi gangs ri'i ra bas bskor ba'i bod yul 'di la/bod dang bod chen po gnyis zhes dbus gtsang dang khams la rim bzhin gsung ba ltar/ bod chen po khams kyi yul phyogs nas gnubs rigs khams ra ba'i mi rgyud las mched pa'i tshan skor zhig smad mdo khams sgang drug gi nang tshan tsong kha zal mo sgang gi ljongs 'dir byon nas khams ra gle lnga chags pa'i lo rgyus byung ba la brten nas gnubs chen rigs rus kyi mi rgyud khams ra ba zhes bod yul mdo smad du grags pa yin/ de yang a chung gnam rdzong gi khor yug 'dir gnubs rigs kyi mi rgyud ma bslebs pa'i yar sngon du stod tsha chen bco brgyad gras kyi bra tshas bzung bar bshad/bra tsha 'di dang po reb gong du gnas bzung ba las/ sde phyed tsam a chung gnam rdzong du yong nas bsdad pa bra tsha stod pa zhes grags shing / bra ma'i stangs par gnas gzhi chags pa reb gong bra tsha smad pa zhes thogs/ phyis su bra tsha smad pa bra ma'i khas nas brag dkar them chen phyogs su song zhing / gnam rdzong bra tsha yang song ba'i shul du khams nas phebs pa'i gnubs rigs khams ra bas 97

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/gnas gzhi bzung bar grags/ des na khams ra'i mi rgyud kyi rigs rus gtso bo ni gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes yin la/khong ni yab gnubs lha lung gsal ba dbang phyug dang / yum mtshams mo bkra shis mtsho'i sras su me mkha' rgya mtsho'i227shing byi spyi lo844lor dpyid zla ra ba'i tshes la dbus ri'i rgyud sgrags kyi phu ru ngo mtshar ba'i ltas mang bo dang bcas sku 'khrungs/ byis pa'i mtshan la skye med rdo rje'i khri gtsug ces btags/ chos ming la sangs rgyas ye shes dang / gsang mtshan la rdo rje yang dbang gter zhes grags/ dgung lo bdun nas 'o bran dpal gyi gzhon nu'i phyag phyir 'brangs nas rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag byang bar mkhyen/ o rgyan chen pos dbang lung dang man ngag mang du gnang /bod kyi mkhas pa gnyags lo ye shes gzhon nu/ sog po dpal gyi ye shes/ grang dpal gyi snying bo/ snyag a tsa ra rgya dpal dbyangs sogs bla ma mang bo bsten/ dgung lo bcu gcig lo nas/ rgya gar dang bal bo phyogs su byon te/ shri steng / bi ma la/ bru sha'i lo tsā ba che btsan skyes sogs bla ma bcu phrag 'ga' bsten pa dang /khyad par de'i nang nas kyang mkhas pa chen po bcu gcig gi zhabs pad bsten nas mdo sngags spyi dang man ngag mtha' yas pa gsan/de yang ji skad du/ skad rigs bdun la mkhas par sbyang ba ni/gnubs kyi lo tsā ba sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs zhes bsngags pa ltar/98

zhar byung /oṃchung gnam rdzong gi mchod gzhis lha sde skor rags tsam brjod pa/khong rgya bal gyi yul du lan bdun byon nas rgyud dang gzhung lugs man ngag mang bo bsgyur gnang mdzad pa'i skad bdun smra ba'i lo tsā ba chen po yin/ rgyal bo glang dar mas bstan pa bsnubs skabs/gnubs chen gyis sdig mdzub cig bstan pas/ mdzub rtse nas sdig pa ra tsa g.yag nag tsam zhig mthong bas rgyal bo skrag ste/gos dkar sngags pa'i rten la nga mi do zer nas/ khyim pa sngags 'chang rnams la de nas bzung 'tshe ba ma byas pas snga 'gyur bstan pa'i rgyun ma chad pa khong gi sku drin yin zhes lo rgyus so sor gleng /skabs der gnubs chen gyis bstan pa bsrung ba'i drag sngags shig dgos par 'dug dgongs nas/ de ma thag bal bor phebs nas bla ma ba su bha ra dang / gtsug lag dpal dge sogs la drag sngags kyi skor mang du zhus nas phyir byon tsa na/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes rgyal bo bkrongs zin pas/ bstan pa srung ba'i drag sngags spu gri reg chod mang bo gter du sbas/ nyung ba dar spel byas/ khong gi gsung rtsom la mdo'i 'grel chen mun pa'i go cha dang / dka' gcod smra ba'i mtshon cha/ sgyu 'phrul brgyad cu'i mngon rtogs 'brel ba/ rdzogs chen man ngag bsam gtan mig sgron sogs mdo sngags kyi bstan bcos mang bo bzhugs/ khong gi sku tshe gcig po ni thos bsam sgom gsum mdzad pa'i sku tshe gcig dang /bstan la mdzad rjes bzhag pa'i sku tshe gcig khyad par du snga 99

ma chung tsām ṣā gi lo rgyus/'gyur bstan pa'i chos rgyun spel ba'i sku tshe mthar phyin pa gcig yin te/ snga 'gyur gyi brgyud tshul la babs lugs chen po gsum grags pa las/ dang po gnyags la babs/ bar du gnubs la babs/ tha mar zur la babs pa gsum du bshad pa las/gnyags dzhan ku ma ra las dpal gyi bu bzhi la brgyud pa dang /yang ar ye shes 'byung gnas la brgyud pa'i khams lugs/ nyang mchog rab la brgyud pa'i nyang lugs/ yang sog po dpal gyi ye shes la gnang nas des gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes la brgyud pa rong lugs/ sog po dpal gyi ye shes nas skor ston shes rab ye shes la brgyud pa'i skor lugs te/ gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes ni bka'i chu bo bzhi 'dus pa yin pas/ snga 'gyur bka' ma'i babs po chen po'i srol 'dzin shing rta chen po zhes kun la grags/ khong gi thugs sras dam pa ba'i khu lung yon tan rgya mtsho dang sras bzhi ni/ swo ye shes dbang phyug dpal gor blon chen 'phags pa/ dan yon tan mchog sru legs pa'i sgron ma bzhi byung / slob rgyud dge mched bco lnga sogs smin par mdzad nas/mthar dgung grangs brgya dang bcu gsum pa me 'brug lor sku mya ngan las 'das so/ /de ltar gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes mchog gi gdung rgyud las rim par byung ba'i ban sngags skya bo cha lugs mi 'dra ba skor zhig snye mo bye mkhar nas gnas spor te thog 100

zhar byung /a chung gnam rdzong gi mchod gzhis lha sde skor rags tsam brjod pa/mar mdo smad a chung gnam rdzong gi nye 'khor bra ma'i la brgal nas gnas gzhi 'tshol bar phyin te/ ban lhas kyi sa cha de dge bcu tshang ba'i gnas su mthong nas gtan sdod byas/ phyugs rgyud mang du 'phel te phyug lhas la rdo ra bskor bas sa de'i ming la ban lhas su thogs/ (khams ra'i lo rgyus tshigs bcad ma tamyu ra'i sgra dbyangagalas ban rnams thog mar bra ma'i la brgal te/ /dge bcu tshang ba'i gnas der phyugs kyi lhas/ /byas pas g.yang mo lug sogs mang 'phel bas/ /lha lam khur byed la yang 'gran zla byas/ /zhes pa ltar/ khyad par g.yang dkar lug gi 'phel kha rgyas te/ lug khyu sprin dkar gyi 'du 'god g.yo ba bzhin byung /gna' dus de lta bu'i rdo ra bskor shul rtswa ring thang sogs su mthong rgyu yod la/ da lta khyim bcu phrag lhag tsam las med/de'i dus ban lhas pa kha shas ha cang stobs 'byor rgyas nas/sngar gyi gnas nas ma shong bar yar spor nas chags te phyug po bang mdzod ldan pa sha stag byung bas ban lhas bang mdzod du grags pa yin te/ (khams ra'i lo rgyus tshigs bcad ma tasbu ra'i sgra dbyangasnyalas/ ha cang 'byor rgyas bang mdzod can 'ga' zhig /de las yar chags longs spyod yar zla bzhin/ /gyur tshe dkor bdag sha za hor mo'i gzugs/ /phyugs rdzi'i zol gyis nyag khar yang yang bud/ /zhes pa ltar/ ban lhas bang mdzod du grags 101

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyugapa de dag longs spyod yar zla bzhin 'phel nas/ lcags thang chu kha rnams su phyugs 'tshos pa'i stabs/ dkor bdag sha za hor mos srung skyob bgyis te/ nags tshal brag gi nyag ga nas bu mo dung ral can zhig phyugs rdzi'i zol gyis yang yang rgyu zhing / hor mo'i gzugs bstan pa yul mi mang bos mthong ba la brten nas hor mo'i nyag kha zhes deng dus kyang grags/ mi rgyud de dag rim par 'phel nas sbrul lce thang du sa bzung bas dud khyim sum cu lhag 'phel ba byung / phyis su sngo rgya 'gag chu glog bzo bkod kyi dbang gis spyi lo1991lor gnubs sde ba dang lhan du gcan tsha rdzong rma mgur dgon dang khad nye ba'i mgur 'og ma bya bar gnas spor byas/ yang(khams ra'i lo rgyus tshigs bcad ma tasmyu ra'i sgra dbyangagalas/ de nas ban de mang du thos pa can/ /rigs rus lang tsho kun gyis rgyag pa zhig /tshur lhags lo tog tshal la rol ba'i tshe/ /'bru drug smin pa'i phung bo ri bzhin spungs/ /zhes pa ltar/ thos pa'i yon tan 'dzoms pa'i ban de rnam dpyod can rigs rus lang tshos rgyags pa zhig yod pa des da lta'i sa 'di zhing las kyi sa bzang bar rtogs nas bdag bzung bgyis te/ zhing rmo 'debs kyis las ka byas pas lo legs bzang bo thob cing / mi rgyud kyang mang du 'phel/ da lta ban rgyags sde ba 'di khyim gzhi bcu phrag gsum lhag tu 'phel yod/ yang〈khams 102

zhar byung /a chung gnam rdzong gi mchod gzhis lha sde skor rags tsam brjod pa/ra'i lo rgyus tshigs bcad ma tasbu ra'i sgra dbyangagalas/ a don skye med rtogs pa'i sngags gzhon zhig pad ma can gyi lus phra mdzes ma dang / /'phrad pa'i dus der lcam dral zung bcas ri/ /mthong yangs ri bo'i rtse mor sba khyim byas/ /zhes pa ltar/ sngon a don skye ba med pa'i chos nyid thugs su chud pa'i gnubs rigs sngags 'chang gzhon nu zhig yod pa des mjos sdug ldan pa'i bu mo gzhon nu ma zhig khyim thabs su bsus nas sba khyim byas te gnag lug rta mdzo sa yi dreg pa bzhin rgyas pa dang / mthar kho'i spun dang sring mo yod pa'i sdod gnas mthong sa zhig tu 'dug par mos nas mthong yangs pa'i sgang kha zhig tu gtan sdod byas/ kho bza' zla gnyis kyi ming don dngos la drangs nas a mdzes zhes grags pa yin/ da lta a mdzes sde ba khyim bcu phrag tsam du 'phel yod/ yang(khams ra'i lo rgyus tshigs bcad ma tasbu ra'i sgra dbyangagalas/ rdzas sngags ting 'dzin bdud rtsis cher myos pa'i//ral 'phur 'khur ldan 'ga' zhig gseg ma'i gnas/ /drag po mngon spyod rol pa'i khug sa ru/ /'tshang pa gsum gyi zlos gar cir yang rtsen/ re 'ga' bco brgyad rdzong du brtul zhugs spyad/ /ma nges sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar gyis/ /'phrin las sna tshogs glog gi 'gyu ba bzhin/ /mdzad pas de yi ming gi brda chad byas/ /zhes pa ltar/ a mjes kyi mi rabs bdun pa'i skabs/ ra 103

bhāchung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/sngags skya bo zhes pa'i rdzas sngags ting 'dzin gyi nus ldan par grags pa'i sngags pa zhig byung nas sa gzhi mthing mdog mngon pa'i gseg khas kyi 'dabs/ sa gru gsum dang gnam gru gsum kha sprod du yod pa'i lte bar gzhis ka bzung ba dang / re 'ga' rdzong chen bco brgyad rnams su brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa mdzad pa sogs drag po'i 'phrin las sna tshogs glog gi 'gyu ba bzhin mdzad pa'i rnam thar bsam gyis mi khyab pa mang ngo / /da lta gseg khas sde ba 'di khyim bcu phrag gsum lhag tu 'phel yod/ yang(khams ra'i lo rgyus tshigs bcad ma tamu ra'i sgra dbyangasalas/ dka' zlog lha mo'i gser gyi gdu bu zhig /sbas pa'i de'u 'bur gong gi nags tshal du/ /gnubs rigs ban sngags zung gi dbang sdud kyi/ /glog zhags bzhi yis brtan g.yo kun la 'khyugs/ /zhes pa ltar/ gnubs rigs ban sngags gnyis kyis de'u gong gi sa bzung ba yin la/ de'u zhes mthong gshol rdzong gi ra bar du de'u 'bur bo zhig yod pa de'i dkyil snying du dka' zlog lha mo'i gser gyi gdub gor zhig gter du sbas yod par grags pa'i gtam rgyud yod pa dang / de'u de'i khor yug tu rang byung nags tshal ra ba bzhin bskor zhing nyams dga' ba'i yul de'i gong nas gzhis bzung bas de'u gong du grags shing / ban sngags gnyis kyis dbang sdud kyi las sgrub pa'i gtam rgyud ngo mtshar can mang bo yod/104

zhar byung / a chung gnam rdzong gi mchod gzhis lha sde skor rags tsam brjod pa/yul mi'i ngag rgyun du'ang / mthing gshol rdzong gi ra bar de'u 'bur zhig /g.yang gi nor bu 'od 'bar dgong du 'phyur/ /khor yug nags dang tshal gyi ra ba'i dbus/ /ban dang sngags kyi sde ru chags pa na/ /de'u gong zhes pa'i ming ni thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bshad do/ /da lta de'u gong sde ba 'di khyim tshang sum cu lhag tu 'phel ba dang / 'di'i khor yug kun tu ri chu nags gsum gyis khebs shing / de'i nang du ri dwags sna tshogs dang / bya byi'u mang bo 'tshe med zhi bde'i ngang bag yangs su rtsen zhing / sngo sman dang rtswa sman/ rang byung thon khungs kyi rigs mang bo 'dzoms pas spyi lo1991lor rgyal khab rim pa'i chog mchan ltar khams ra rgyal khab nags tshal spyi gling gi lte gnas su gyur yod/ yang(khams ra'i lo rgyus tshigs bcad ma tasbu ra'i sgra dbyangagalas/ gos dkar lcang lo 'chang ba'i rgan po zhig /sa dkar lung nas nags kyi spyil bu ru/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sgom bzlas la zhugs tshe/ /dgyes 'dzum zhal gyi dkyil 'khor yang yang bstan/ /zhes pa ltar/ khams mi sngags 'chang phebs pa'i gras kyi gos dkar gyon pa'i rgan po zhig bzlas brjod sgom sgrub byed par mos nas dben gnas shig btsal te/ sa dkar lung thugs la babs te nags kyi spyil bu phug nas bzhugs/ thugs rje chen po'i rnal 105

spochung gnam rdzong gi lo sa/ 'byor la rtse gcig tu gzhol zhing sgrub pa mdzad pas/ 'phags pa'i zhal mthong ba dang / sdig sgrib zhi ba'i rtags mtshan thob pa sogs kyi rnam thar byung bar grags la/ dkar bo lung zhes pa'i sde 'di la phyi'i srung ba bzhi tshang ba'i sa bshad 'di 'dra zhig yod de/ shar gyi stag skya bo gzhi bdag a mye khra se la zer/ lhor g.yu 'brug sngon mo rdza gnam lha chen mo la zer/ nub kyi bya dmar bo brag bya 'phur sgang la zer/ byang rus sbal ser bo ri zhogs ma'i ngos la zer/ 'di bzhi gzugs dbyibs dang kha dog gsal bo rang byon du yod/ phyis su gnas 'dir sde chags pa dkar bo nang khyim bcu drug sogs byung ba dang 'gram tshang gi sde rnams 'phel ba yin no/ /da lta dkar bo lung sde ba khyim tshang sum cu lhag tsam yod dang 'gram tshang sde ba yang khyim tshang sum cu lhag tu 'phel yod/ yang(khams ra'i lo rgyus tshigs bcad ma tamyu ra'i sgra dbyangasalas/ spun gsum 'bring bo rma klung g.yas 'khyil khug /dge bcu'i dpal gyis mdzes pa'i do ra ru/ /phun tshogs sde bzhi'i 'byor bas yongs gtams pa'i/ /lus sems bde skyid lhas su mtsho bzhin 'khyil/ /zhes pa ltar/ khams nas phebs pa'i gnubs rigs kyi gtso khyim 'dzin pa gnubs chen po'i spun ji'abring bo de nyid kyis/ sum pa 'gags kyi mar phyogs rma klung g.yas su 'khyil ba'i 'gram khug tu gnas gzhi bzung / sa 106

zhar byung / ma chung gnam rdzong gi mchod gzhis lha sde skor rags tsam brjod pa/phyogs gtsang zhing spang thang rnam par bkra ba'i ljongs der lus sems bde skyid ldan par gnas pas na skyid lhas su grags/mang tshogs gtam rgyud du grags pa'i bsngags brjod du'ang / rma klung g.yas su 'khyil ba'i 'gram khug tu/ /skyid po'i bkod pa zhing gi dpal la 'gran/ /lus can kun dga'i dpyid kyi pho nya yis/ /sngon bsu nam zla gsar tshes slebs pa ru/ /'dab ldan pad+ma'i 'dzum zhal ngom pa na/ /sems med pa yi ljon pa ldem se ldem/ /ma bos 'dab chags skad snyan lhang se lhang / /btab pa'i lo tog snye ma g.yur du za/ /ma btab shing gi 'bras bu mngar mo'i zas/ /gang ci 'dod pa'i skyid lhas ra ba ru/ /bza' zla mched nas skyid lhas sde ru chags/ /zhes bshad pa bzhin no/ /da lta sde yar kha mar kha gnyis khyim tshang drug cu lhag tu 'phel/ spyi lo1995lor sngo rgya 'gag chu glog sa tshigs bzo skrun gyis dbang gis gnas 'di dang gyes te do rgya zhang lha grong sde 'dabs kyi lha mdun thang bya bar gnas spar nas sngon ltar ya rabs dam pa'i srol bzang las ma 'gongs par chos srid kyi 'tsho ba'i rgyun skyong bzhin yod do/ /yang(khams ra'i lo rgyus tshigs bcad ma tasbu ra'i sgra dbyangasulas/ spun tha khams chung klu rgyal nyer dga' bo'i/ /khang steng rin chen gser gyi bum pa'i spor/ /chags pas nor gyi 107

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/dbang phyug gnod sbyin ltar/ /mi rabs longs spyod nam mkha' mdzod du gyur/ /zhes pa ltar gnubs chen gyi spun tha chung yin pas khams chung du grags shing / khams chung ba de nyid kyi rang gang 'dod pa'i gzhis shig btsal nas mkhar bskyil bas zhing phyugs gnyis kyi 'byor ba rgyas shing gter bdag lta bur gyur/de la rgya nag sang sha'i sa dpyad pa zhig gis bltas pas/ klu'i pho brang gi steng gser gyi bum pa bzhag 'dra'i thog la khel yod pas/mi rabs kun tu rgyu nor gyi nyams pa med pa'i ngag rgyun grags yod/yang mang tshogs ngag rgyun gyi bstod par/ khams kyi chung ba klu sgrub sprul ba can/ /bsod nams dbang thang stong gi mnga' bdag ste/ /klu rgyal dga' ba'i gtsug gi nor bu'i steng / /sa mkhar smug po'i gru rtse mkha' la bsnyegs/ /phyogs bzhir g.yur du za ba'i ljon shing btsugs/ /btab pa'i lo tog phung bo ri ltar spungs/ /dpal 'byor 'dzad med dbyar gyi char sprin bzhin/ /phywa g.yang legs tshogs 'dod dgu klu yi gter/ /nam yang mi zad khams chung zhes su grags/ /zhes bsngags pa ltar da lta khams chung sde ba khyim tshang sum cu tsam la nye bar 'phel nas zhing phyugs kyi 'byor ba sngar las gong du 'phel te bde skyid kyi 'tsho ba la mngon par rol ba'i skabs nyid do/ /108

zhar byung / ma chung gnam rdzong gi mchod gzhis lha sde skor rags tsam brjod pa/yang(khams ra'i lo rgyus tshigs bcad ma tasbu ra'i sgra dbyangasalas/ spun rgan gnubs chen shar gyi phyogs mtha'i gnas/ /bco brgyad rdzong gi 'dus mdo'i sgo mo ru/ /dbang chen pad+ma gsung gi 'phrin las kyis/ /sna tshogs cir yang rol ba'i zlos gar rtsen/ /zhes pa ltar/ gnubs chen rigs sngags 'dzin pa de nyid/ yul 'di'i rdzong chen bco brgyad kyi mdo'i sgo mo lta bu'i gnad sar/ rma chu dang / ban gro gnubs gram pa bcas kyi chu bo rdo rje rgya gram sa la btab pa lta bu'i dbyibs su shar ba'i ra mtshams la gnas gzhi bzung nas bzhugs te/ pad+ma dbang chen gsung gi sgrub pa mdzad pas 'phrin las kyi rtags mtshan byung bas/ las kyi bya ba sna tshogs 'grub pa'i rnam thar ha cang mang bo yod/ skabs shig la yul 'dir sa bdag gi nad kyis zin pa mang du byung skabs brag dmar seng ge sgra'i rtser sgrub pa mdzad pas nad de dag yongs su zhi ba dang / yul 'dir rgol ba'i dgra sde'i tshogs snga phyir lan kha shas byung ba rnams kyang /mngon spyod drag po'i las kyis tshar bcad pa sogs chos dang srid kyi las don gang la yang phyag rjes rlabs chen bzhag de nas gnubs chen gyi rigs rgyud mang du 'phel nas gnubs yar kha dar rgyas su song zhing / de nas gnubs mar kha rim par 'phel nas khyim bcu phrag du ma byung ba dang bstun rma phar ka 'phel ba 109

spochung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/gnubs ban gro zhes pa yin/ phyis su ban gro zer ba kha skad du 'gyur song ma gtogs sa dbyibs pad+ma 'dra ba la chags pas na pad ro zhes grags pa don la gnas so// spyi lo1991lor/sngo rgya 'gag chu glog bzo bkod kyi dbang gis gnubs sde ba gnyis dang sbrul rtse sde ba gcig tu bsres pa'i dud khyim brgya phrag lhag tsam da lta gcan tsha rdzong rma mgur dgon dang khad nye sa mgur 'og ma bya bar gnas spar te/ rigs rus gtsang ma gzhan dang ma bsres par ya rabs srol bzang gi 'tsho ba'i mngar kha myong bzhin pa'i skabs lags so/ /de ltar gna' bo'i dus kyi khams ra gle lnga brtsi tshul ni/ ban lhas/ a mdzes/ skyid lhas/khams chung / gnubs bcas lnga yin la/ phyis su 'phel rgyas byung nas/ de'u gong dang dkar bo lung / 'gram tshang gle gcig gnubs yar ka mar kha dang phar ka'i ban gro gle gcigakhams chung skyid lhas gle gcig a mdzes dang ban lhas gle gcig ban rgyag dang gseg khas gle gcig bcas sde ba gle lngar bgrang ba dang / nye sngon rdzong so so'i mnga' khongs bgo tshul gyis/gnubs yar kha mar kha gle gcig de'u gong dkar po lung gle gcig a mdzes ban lhas gle gcig ban rgyag gseg khas gle gcig skyid lhas khams chung gle gcig ste gle lngar brtsi ba yin no/ /de ltar gle lnga'i sde ba de dag las/ dkar bo nang dang de'u gong 110

zhar byung /a chung gnam rdzong gi mchod gzhis lha sde skor rags tsam brjod pa/dang po'i gle ru mi gtogs kyang / 'phrin las rnam lnga 'grub pa'i gnas lnga zhes pa'i nang du 'du ste/ zhi ba'i las 'grub pa'i gnas dkar po lung dang / rgyas pa'i las 'grub pa'i gnas ban lhas dang skyid lhas khams chung gsum dang / dbang gi las 'grub pa'i gnas de'u gong / drag po'i las 'grub pa'i gnas gseg khas/ las bzhi sna tshogs 'grub pa'i gnas gnubs yin par gsungs so/ /khams ra gle lnga nas 'khrungs pa'i mkhas grub rim byon ni/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje'i slob rgyud du gtogs shing drag po mngon spyod kyi las mnan sreg 'phang gsum dang / rim gnyis bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i ting 'dzin la mnga' dbang 'byor ba'i gseg khas sde ba nas sku 'khrungs pa'i sngags 'chang ra thod gdug dang ra skya bo/ sum mdo bla ma/ khams chung sde ba nas sku 'khrungs pa'i thang skam bla ma tshang / ban rgyag sde ba nas 'khrungs pa'i sngags 'chang nus ldan 'ga'/ de'u gong sde ba nas 'khrungs pa'i nags kha'i sngags 'chang / g.yis tshang tsho ba'i sngags 'chang sogs rig 'dzin sngags 'chang 'di dag gis phan tshun la grub pa'i rtags mtshan mang du bstan pa dad pa'i gsos su mchis mod 'dir zhib tu mi spro/ dkar bo lung sde ba nas sku 'khrungs pa'i dkar bo sku skyes zhes pa mkhas pa'i snyan pa ches cher rgyas pa zhig byung / a mdzes sde ba nas 'khrungs pa'i dkar nag rtsis kyi 111

ma chung gnam rdzongasha lo rgyugagazhung brgyar byang ba'i rtsis pa lug thong ma/ skyid lhas dpon tshang nas sku 'khrungs shing tshe lus gcig la rdo rje 'chang gi sar gshegs pa'i bla ma chos dbyings rang grol tshang / yang skyid lhas sde ba nas sku 'khrungs shing gzhan phan byang chub sems kyis thugs rgyud phyug cing / rim gnyis rtogs pa mchog gi klong brdol ba'i grub brnyes rig 'dzin chen mo glag tshang mtshams rgan tshang /de'i sku skyes skyid lhas rdo ring kha tsho skor nas sku 'khrungs shing /mdo sngags gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son zhing khyad par gsang chen a ti yo ga'i zab lam la brten nas kun mkhyen yab sras kyi dgongs pa mthil rtogs mdzad pa'i sprul sku 'jigs med rnam grol tshang / snga 'gyur gzhung lugs kun la nang byan chud cing / dbang lung khrid gsum dang brgyud gsum man ngag gi gter du grub pa'i khams ra'i mkhan po rnam gsum ste/ khams chung skal bzang tshang / a mjos bstan 'dzin tshang / dkar bo lung pad+ma don grub tshang / mdo rgyud bstan bcos rgya mtsho'i gzhung la nang byan chud cing yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed la brten nas bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin pa'i gnubs mar ka'i rdo mkhar mtshams pa 'jam dpal rdo rje rin po che tshang /mdo sngags rig gnas spyi dang khyad par snga 'gyur rgyal bstan gyi srog shing gcig pu/ da lta'i snyigs ma'i 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs 112

zhar byung / a chung gnam rdzong gi mchod gzhis lha sde skor rags tsam brjod pa/mgon chen mo mchog sprul 'jam dbyangs chos 'phel dpal bzang bo'am mtshan gzhan sprul sku grol lo sogs kyis mtshon gnubs khams ra gle lnga'i sde 'di nas mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes chen mang bo bar ma chad par byon myong / gnas 'di'i sgrub phug rnams ngos 'dzin ni/ gnam rdzong rtser mkhas pa mi gsum sgrub phug dang / zangs mdog dpal ri'i sgrub phug slob dpon pad+mas lung gis zin pa'i ma sangs 'gengs pa'i phug pa bcas yod/sde brgyad rdzong du skyes chen mang po bzhugs pa'i sgrub gnas byin can yod/ 'ug rdzong du lha lung dpal rdor gyi sgrub phug dang klad du mchod rten rang byon yod/ jo mo sgom khang du sngon rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i stod tsam la btsun ma ye shes sgrol ma zer ba rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin nas mchog gi dngos grub thob pa zhig yod/ nyin zhig kho mo'i dge phrug chu len du song nas phyir yong dus btsun ma ye shes sgrol ma sgrub khang kha gtad kyi mis bgrod mi thub pa'i brag ri'i rtser bzhugs yod pa mthong bas/dge phrug ngu zhing smre ngag bton pa na/ btsun ma ye shes sgrol ma na re/ nga'i sgrub khang gi bzhugs shul na ril bu dang bgrang phreng yod/ ril bu zo la phreng ba sker 'phangs na nga yod sar bsleb thub ces pa ltar bsgrubs pas der bslebs/ btsun mas nga ni 'ja' lus grub pa yin/ bu khyod nga yi rjes su zhugs/ /bslab 113

bhāca sam rdzong gi lo rgyugapa ma g.yol sgrub la brtson/ /phyi mar dbus gtsang zhing nas 'phrad/ /ces pa'i ngo mtshar pa'i rnam thar byung bar brten jo mo rdzong ngam jo mo sgom khang zhes grags/ brag dmar seng ge rdzong mtshams khang du glo ge sgra rang byon 'bur du dod pa yod/ ra gzhi rdzong rgyab kyi kha la yug mtshams khang du sngon grub chen zhig gis mdzub mo gsum brag ngos su btsugs pa'i shul gyi khung bu nas gnas chu 'bab pa yod/ mgon po rdzong mtshams khang du sngon ko'u ba chos rgya mtshos mgon po sgrub nas zhal gzigs mthong ba dang / phyis su skyes chen mang po zam ma chad par bzhugs myong /glag tshang mtshams khang du sngon glag tshang mtshams rgan rin po che tshe gang bor bzhugs nas grub pa brnyes/ chu mgo dkar bo'i mtshams khang du rdo ring kha 'jigs med rnam grol dang bya btang ba mang bo bzhugs/ mgon ka'i mtshams khang du grub chen karma dgra 'joms tshang yun ring bzhugs myong / khyi gu mdo'i mtshams khang dang / gle rgan mtshams khang / dril bu sgang mtshams khang /bkag nags mtshams khang sogs su bla ma chos dbyings rang grol tshang lo mang bor bzhugs nas thugs dam nyams bzhes mdzad/bkra shis mtshams khang dang / khra se rdzo mtshams khang / rgyab skyid mtshams khang / gnas spo rdzong klad kyi mtshams khang / smug po rdzong klad kyi mtshams khang rnams su sngon mkhas shing grub pa'i dam pa 114

zhar byung /a chung gnam rdzong gi mchod gzhis lha sde skor rags tsam brjod pa/mang po bzhugs myong bar grags/ de yang dang po khams ra ba rnams kyi las don gnubs chen gyis bzung zhing / yul 'di'i chos srid kyi las don yar rgyas zla med du bskyangs pa dang / de'i rjes nas khams ra ba rnams kyi dpon po gle lnga'i tsho ba so so'i nang nas spyi 'dem gyis thon dgos la/ spyi sems can gyi mi sna gang bzang gis dpon byas nas lo ngo brgya phrag du ma zhig song ba yin/dus phyis su gle lnga'i nang gi dpon po gang bskos la rka phug sgar bas rta chen res bdag chen mdzad pa'i lugs srol dar yod/phyis kyi dpon po grags che ba'i nang nas skyid lhas dpon po rgan a 'brug dang / dpon po bsam 'grub rdo rje/ ban rgyag dpon po rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / dpon po tshe brtan rdo rje/ thang shang sgar ba/ thang skam bla ma/ ban rgyag dpon po dbang chen/ a mdzes dpon po bkra lo/ dkar bo lung sgang ba'i dpon po pad+ma dbang rgyal/ sum mdo bla ma sogs mi sna grags can gang yod kyis dpon byas pa yin la/ phyis kyi dus tsam la/ skyid lhas dpon po pad+ma rdo rje'i skabs khams ra gle lnga do kya'i dpon gyi mnga' 'og tu tshud kyang / de'i rjes skyid lhas dpon po bsam 'grub rdo rje dpon sar bskos nas khams ra'i 'go 'dzin byas te khams ra do kya'i mnga' 'og nas phyir 'then byas shing / gle lnga'i las don legs par bskyangs pas mtshan snyan che ba byung ste/ zi ling 115

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/dpon pos byu ru'i tog bkod pa'i las zhwa dang / ches mtho'i gzengs bstod thob/ dpon de nyid kyis gle lnga'i srid phyogs dar rgyas kyi mdun lam la dmigs nas/ mi nyag gi rgya yig mkhas pa zhig gdan drangs te/ rgya dur khug tu rgya yig slob grwa'i gzhi chags par byas pa dang / mang tshogs kyi dgos mkhor tshong khang btsugs pa sogs rig gnas dpal 'byor phyogs la thabs jus mang du bton kyang khong 'das rjes rgyun skyong mkhan nyag phra bar gyur song / de'i rjes su gnubs dpon po 'jigs byed kyis dpon sa bzung bas gnubs dpon tshang du grags/ de'i rjes su gnubs dpon po dbang chen gyis khams ra gle lnga'i dpon byas nas chos srid kyi bya ba mtha' dag yar ldan du bskyangs shing /gnam rdzong gi dgon sde khag la khyad med kyis bsnyen bkur mdzad pa yin/ krung go gung khran tang gis bcings 'grol byas pa nas gcan tsha rdzong tang u dang / rdzong mi dmangs srid gzhung gi yang dag pa'i 'go khrid 'og khams ra grong rdal mi dmangs srid gzhung tshugs shing / thad kar rlabs chen gyi khrid ston byas pas/khams ra mi dmangs kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor rig gnas bcas kyi las don dbyar mtsho bzhin gong 'phel chen po byung ste/ cisngon thon gyi dus rabs gsar ba'i 'tsho ba dngos su rol 'go tshugs pa yin no/ /116

zhar byung / a chung gnam rdzong gi mchod gzhis lha sde skor rags tsam brjod pa/smras pa/ grub brnyes rig 'dzin gnubs chen mchog gi rigs rus man+da ra ba'i 'bras/ /khardzus kyi seng khrog gser ldan byo bar du mar smin pa'i dge mtshan gyis/ /phun tshogs sde bzhi g.yang gi 'dab stong mi rabs kun tu mngon bzhad pas/ /chos srid phan bde'i dri ngad zhim pos snyigs ma'i khyon du dge legs bstsal/ /117

mjug bsdu ba'i gtam/'dzam gling snying bo dbus 'gyur tshal gyi byang / /kha ba'i lhun po spungs pa'i zhing mchog tu/ /mi rje lha yis mdzad pa'i ya mtshan gtam/ /deng yang ma nyams rigs drug kha las sgrog /khyad par sprul ba'i lo paṇa rim byon dang / /gnam bskos sa dbang brgya yis thabs shes kyis/ /lugs gnyis khrims kyi rtsibs stong 'khor lo'i zil/ /mtha' bzhi'i dbyig 'dzin lha mo'i khyon du bsgyur/ /'on kyang bdud sde 'byung bos yid dkrugs pa'i/ /mi dbang dar ma'i log pa'i bsam sbyor gyis/ /phan bde'i rtsa ba mnyam med shākya'i bstan/ /sdig pa'i dpung tshogs bzhi yis rmang nas bshigs/ /de nas smon lam 'bum gyi mthu grub pa'i/ /zla med mkhas pa dmar g.yo gtsang gsum gyis/ /mdo smad gnas yongs kyi phyi mo 'dir/ /phyi dar bstan pa'i me ro slar yang gsos/gu ru'i rje 'bangs dpal gyi rdo rje dang / /bstan pa'i rtsa lag dgongs pa rab gsal gyis/ /mdo sngags chos kyi gru char sil ma 'bum/ /gnas 'di gtso byas gangs dkar khyon du gtor/ /snga 'gyur bstan pa'i bka' babs shing rta che/ /grub pa'i rig 'dzin 118

mjug bku ba'i gtam/gnubs chen sangs rgyas kyi/ /rus las mched pa'i ban sngags lhan 'dzoms kyis/ /gnas 'di bdag gir bgyis pa'i gtam de snyan/ /'on kyang chos kun chu zla'i rdzun ris kyi/ /mi rtag sgyu ma'i gar gyi rjes 'gro bas/ /gnas mchog gang dang grong sde'i lo rgyus kyang / /dga' skyo spel ma'i gar las cang ma mchis/ /de lta na'ang snyigs ma'i yang mtha' 'dir/ /nyon mongs kho nas 'tsho ba'i brgya lam na/ /rnam dkar legs byas ming tsam bsgrubs na yang / /don yod mthong nas las 'di nan gyis byas/ /nga rgyal dbugs kyi rtseg ma cher 'don zhing / /phrag dog dug lce g.yo ba'i tshogs rnams la/ /ci byas zug rngu bskyed pa'i rgyur 'gro bas/ /snying rje'i mchi ma 'don las thabs gzhan ci/ /dad gsum me tog 'chang ba'i skal bzang dang / /gzur gnas lhag bsam ldan pa'i rigs can la/ /nyam chung dbul bos bskrun pa'i deb chung 'di/ /gus pa'i nyams kyis legs pa'i skyes su btegs/ /'dis mtshon dge bas grangs med 'jig rten du/ /nad yams mu ge 'thab rtsod mi 'byung zhing / /mdo sngags rgyal bstan yun ring gnas pa dang / /mkha' khyab 'gro la zhi bde yong bar shog /ces gangs can nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i snyan gong na mtshan snyan gyi rin chen rna cha mngon par g.yo ba'i nges pa don gyi gnas mchog phyi dar bstan pa'i chu mgor grags pa'i mdo smad a chung 119

a chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/gnam rdzong dang / gnubs khams ra'i sa khul du nang bstan rig gnas lo rgyus kyi byung ba ring zhing / dmangs khrod rig gnas sgyu rtsal cung dar cha che ba dang / /rang byung gi ri chu nags gsum rgya che zhing / ri skyes srog chags kyi rigs shin tu mang ba/sngo sman dang rtswa sman gyi sna mang zhing / snod kyi bkod pa la mdzes sdug gi che ba mang du 'dzoms pas/ spyi lo1991lor rgyal khab rim pa'i nags tshal spyi gling gi mtshan snyan thob pa nas bzung /rang rgyal dang phyi gling ba'i mi rigs mang bo lo re bzhin lta skor dang / lo rgyus zhib 'jug la phebs nas yul 'di'i lugs gnyis kyi lo rgyus rin thang la dpyod pas tshad 'jal bzhin yod/de dang 'brel gnam rdzong spyi'i lo rgyus dang nang gses dgon sde khag byung tshul la don dngos dang mi mthun pa'i 'brel brjod dang /phyogs lhung gis 'chal rtsom spel yod pa de dag da lta rgyal spyi'i glog klad dra tshigs dang dpe deb mang bo'i nang bkod yod par brten/ bdag la mchog dman gyi skye bo su zhig gi bskul slong med par/ thog mar rdzun bzo dang phyogs lhung gi dri mas rang sems mi gos pa'i blo sbyong sngon du btang nas/ci yul 'di'i sngar yod kyi lo rgyus nyung shas dag la dpyad pa'i gzhi bcol te/ lo rgyus smra ba dag la bcar 'dri dang / tshad ldan gyi ngag rgyun/ rgyu cha 'tshol sdud la sogs pa'i khur rang gcig pus theg par byas te 120

mjug bsdu ba'i gtam/zla gnyis tsam la hur brtson byas mthar/ rgyas bsdus 'tsham pa'i lo rgyus 'di tsam zhig brtsams grub byung / 'on kyang kho bo ni/chos 'byung dang / lo rgyus/ rig pa'i gnas gang la'ang mthong thos khron sbal las chung bas na/ klog pa po phal ba zhig gi thugs kyang tshims mi thub mod/ ma 'ongs pa na yul phyogs 'di'i lo rgyus rgyas pa zhig 'bri mi 'byung nges pa can yin pas/ de'i skabs su kho bo'i deb chung 'di de'i sa bon gyi dod tsam du phan e srid snyam pa'i kun nas bslangs te 'bad brtson bgyis pa ltar lags na/ rgya che ba'i klog mkhan yongs kyis nongs pa'i cha ci mchis pa thams cad la lhag bsam gyi skyon brjod dang dag ther byed par phran gyis lag zung snying gar sbyar nas bka' drin che zhu ba dang chabs cig deb chung 'di zhu dag dang sngon 'gro'i gsal bshad 'bri mkhan gcan tsha rdzong mi rigs slob 'bring dang po'i slob dpon chen mo sangs rgyas rin chen lags la yang sems khong nas thugs rje che zhu ba yin/ zhes spyi lo2007lo'i lugs rnying gi hor zla9ba'i tshes8nyin gcan tsha mda' mo g.yang gi rdzong nas sbyar ba'o/ /121

ma chung gnam rdzong gi lo rgyus/bka' drin lu yig dang bsngo smon/deb chung 'di par sgrun gyi thad la ma dngul gyi rogs skyor gnang mkhan mtsho sngon nang bstan slob gling gi dge rgan chen mo ldong bsod nams rgya mtsho dang / khu bo dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ tshe gcig grogs kyi dwangs ma gcan khams blo bzang bzod pa/ khri g.yag kun dga' tshul khrims/ zhang bo klu sgrub/ phu bo blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ rdzong dpon lha skyabs rgyal/ gnubs skal bzang /skyid gle 'jigs med/ (rwa 4hwarki)bang shin ma'e khyim mi gang bo/ (oṃcholhohrehwarki)shis len krin khyim mi gang bo/ (7chocho)hrin krin ma'e/(lolkohre.oṃrki) lo'u len khyim mi gang bo/(sa yi〉)dpung ye tan/ (lkoṭha2)krang grod long bcas la lhag bsam rnam par dag pas bka' drin lan brgyar zhu/ sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /tshe 'dir bsam pa'i don 'grub cing / /bar chad zhi nas bkra shis pa/ /bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog /bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan//bstan 'dzin skyes bu sa steng yongs la khyab/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor ba rgyas/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen ba dang / /kun tu bzang bo de yang de bzhin te/ /de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag slob phyir/ /dge ba 'di dag thams cad rab tu bsngo/ /dus gsum gshegs pa'i rgyal ba thamase cad kyis/ /bsngo ba gang la mchog tu bsngags pa des/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di kun kyang / /bzang bo spyod phyir rab tu bsngo bar bgyi/ /122
